note: Source: Anthropic's official CHANGELOG.md (https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) and npm publish times, synced daily. Original text © Anthropic. Dates and times are UTC. Curated by @ Xiaoyu Gao: https://github.com/gaoxiaoyu1228/claude-code-changelog-calendar

entries.en: Added Code Mode support in terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS
entries.zh: 在 AWS 上的 Amazon Bedrock、Google Cloud 代理平台、Microsoft Foundry 和 Claude Platform 上的终端会话中添加了代码模式支持

entries.en: Added `oidc.groups_jsonpath` to the Claude apps gateway, to read groups from the matching entries of a list of objects with a small subset of JSONPath (RFC 9535)
entries.zh: 将`oidc.groups_jsonpath`添加到 Claude 应用程序网关，以从具有 JSONPath 小子集的对象列表的匹配条目中读取组（RFC 9535）

entries.en: Added an API connectivity section to `claude doctor` that reports whether the API can be reached, with the HTTP status or the error, or says why it wasn't tested
entries.zh: 在`claude doctor`中添加了 API 连接部分，报告是否可以访问 API、HTTP 状态或错误，或者说明为什么未测试它

entries.en: Added a notice when tap-mode voice dictation stops by itself, after 15 seconds without recognized speech or at its 2-minute limit
entries.zh: 添加了当点击模式语音听写在 15 秒内没有识别到语音或达到 2 分钟限制后自行停止时的通知

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_RESPONSE_COMPRESSION` to ask for uncompressed model responses behind a proxy that cuts compressed ones off; not advised yet for self-hosted runners or Remote Control
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_RESPONSE_COMPRESSION`以请求代理后面的未压缩模型响应，该代理会切断压缩响应；尚不建议用于自托管运行程序或远程控制

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_IDP_CONNECT_BY_HOSTNAME=1` for Claude apps gateways: with `oidc.use_proxy: true`, sign-in requests hand the proxy an `https` IdP's hostname even with `NO_PROXY` set
entries.zh: 为 Claude 应用程序网关添加了`CLAUDE_GATEWAY_IDP_CONNECT_BY_HOSTNAME=1`：使用`oidc.use_proxy: true`，登录请求会将`https`IdP 的主机名传递给代理，即使设置了`NO_PROXY`

entries.en: Added `gen_ai.usage.*`, `gen_ai.response.model` and `gen_ai.operation.name` to `claude_code.llm_request` trace spans; `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens` includes prompt cache tokens
entries.zh: 将`gen_ai.usage.*`、`gen_ai.response.model`和`gen_ai.operation.name`添加到`claude_code.llm_request`跟踪范围； `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens` 包含提示缓存令牌

entries.en: Added `optionalDependencies` to plugin manifests: plugins that install with the plugin listing them and can be disabled or uninstalled on their own
entries.zh: 在插件清单中添加了“可选依赖项”：与列出它们的插件一起安装的插件，可以自行禁用或卸载

entries.en: Improved typing speed in screen reader mode, most of all in long sessions
entries.zh: 提高了屏幕阅读器模式下的打字速度，尤其是在长时间会话中

entries.en: Improved start-up time: a session started soon after another no longer waits for the model list, and one outside a git repository without `.claude/settings.local.json` no longer waits on git
entries.zh: 改进的启动时间：一个接着一个启动的会话不再等待模型列表，并且 git 存储库外部没有 `.claude/settings.local.json` 的会话不再等待 git

entries.en: Improved the plugin auto-update notice to name plugins it newly installs as dependencies, separately from updated plugins
entries.zh: 改进了插件自动更新通知，将新安装的插件命名为依赖项，与更新的插件分开

entries.en: Improved Code Mode tool search to show more of an MCP tool's description, with its limits, formats and defaults
entries.zh: 改进了代码模式工具搜索，以显示 MCP 工具的更多描述及其限制、格式和默认值

entries.en: Improved the Console sign-in link shown by /login and `claude auth login --console`: it is now much shorter
entries.zh: 改进了 /login 和 `claude auth login --console` 显示的控制台登录链接：现在更短了

entries.en: Improved Claude's list of your artifacts: it now marks web pages, so Claude is less likely to try opening one with the Claude Docs connector
entries.zh: 改进了克劳德的工件列表：它现在标记网页，因此克劳德不太可能尝试使用克劳德文档连接器打开网页

entries.en: Improved the folder trust prompts in short terminals: fullscreen `/cd` and `/add-dir` show their choices in fewer rows, and the prompt at launch keeps the folder path in view when it has many warnings
entries.zh: 改进了短终端中的文件夹信任提示：全屏`/cd`和`/add-dir`以更少的行显示它们的选择，并且启动时的提示在出现许多警告时会保留文件夹路径

entries.en: Changed the questions for stopping auto-connect in `/ide` and for `/clear`, `/compact` or `/rewind` in a subagent's view to list Yes first; they still start on No, so Down then Enter now answers No
entries.zh: 将`/ide`中停止自动连接的问题以及子代理视图中`/clear`、`/compact`或`/rewind`的问题更改为首先列出“是”；他们仍然从“否”开始，所以向下然后输入现在回答“否”

entries.en: Changed what a `PermissionDenied` hook's `retry: true` tells Claude: make the refused call again only if you asked for that call
entries.zh: 更改了`PermissionDenied`钩子的`retry: true`告诉 Claude 的内容：仅当您请求该调用时才再次进行被拒绝的调用

entries.en: Changed in a future release, on or after November 30, 2026: plugin marketplaces in managed `extraKnownMarketplaces` will auto-update by default. To opt one out, set `"autoUpdate": false` on its entry
entries.zh: 在 2026 年 11 月 30 日或之后的未来版本中进行了更改：托管`extraKnownMarketplaces`中的插件市场将默认自动更新。要选择退出，请在其条目上设置 `"autoUpdate": false`

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool calls hanging for up to 30 minutes on some malformed replies from a local or WebSocket server
entries.zh: 修复了来自本地或 WebSocket 服务器的某些格式错误的回复导致 MCP 工具调用挂起长达 30 分钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed PushNotification telling a headless run, such as a scheduled one, that the terminal was active in its first minute, instead of saying whether a mobile push was requested
entries.zh: 修复了 PushNotification，告诉无头运行（例如计划的运行）终端在第一分钟内处于活动状态，而不是说明是否请求移动推送

entries.en: Fixed `/install-github-app` skipping the repository step after setup warnings when no repository was found, and Esc not going back from its workflow list and sign-in steps
entries.zh: 修复了`/install-github-app`在未找到存储库时在设置警告后跳过存储库步骤，并且 Esc 不会从其工作流程列表和登录步骤返回的问题

entries.en: Fixed one-line tool results cut with no ellipsis in narrow windows, Markdown stars in the Auto mode tab of /permissions, and a hook's reason to stop a forked skill showing twice
entries.zh: 修复了在狭窄窗口中没有省略号的单行工具结果剪切、/permissions 的自动模式选项卡中的 Markdown 星号以及钩子阻止分叉技能显示两次的原因

entries.en: Fixed `/diff` hiding its key hints and not selecting files in windows of 24 to 26 rows, and leaving out files added with `git add -N` in a repository with no commits
entries.zh: 修复了`/diff`隐藏其关键提示，并且不在 24 到 26 行的窗口中选择文件，并在没有提交的存储库中遗漏使用`git add -N`添加的文件

entries.en: Fixed the first-run theme list showing too few themes in short windows, and /usage and other tall screens coming out garbled there
entries.zh: 修复了首次运行的主题列表在短窗口中显示的主题太少，以及 /usage 和其他高屏幕出现乱码的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/bug` in fullscreen hiding its Yes and No answers behind a long report, and Yes staying out of view in very short windows
entries.zh: 修复了全屏中的`/bug`，将其“是”和“否”答案隐藏在长报告后面，并且“是”在非常短的窗口中保持在视图之外

entries.en: Fixed /compact and auto-compact sometimes losing part of the conversation summary when the summary quoted certain XML tags
entries.zh: 修复了当摘要引用某些 XML 标签时，/compact 和自动压缩有时会丢失部分对话摘要的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude not being told when permission rules on the Agent tool dropped its queued message to a subagent that had already ended
entries.zh: 修复了当代理工具上的权限规则将其排队消息丢弃到已结束的子代理时，克劳德没有被告知的问题

entries.en: Fixed a Remote Control message sometimes showing above the reply that was finishing when it was sent
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制消息有时会显示在发送时正在完成的回复上方

entries.en: Fixed Stop hooks that read the transcript missing the last reply in Claude Desktop; SubagentStop hooks now wait for it too
entries.zh: 修复了读取 Claude Desktop 中缺少最后回复的记录的 Stop 挂钩； SubagentStop 挂钩现在也在等待它

entries.en: Fixed turns and subagents failing in cloud sessions, or timing out on long replies elsewhere, when a reply went silent while Claude was still thinking; Claude Code now tries the request once more
entries.zh: 修复了云会话中的回合和子代理失败的问题，或者当克劳德仍在思考时回复沉默时在其他地方的长回复超时的问题；克劳德·科德现在再次尝试该请求

entries.en: Fixed Esc and Stop waiting about a minute or more when the contents of a cloud or network file that Claude is reading stall
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude 正在读取的云或网络文件的内容停滞时，Esc 和 Stop 等待大约一分钟或更长时间

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode sessions resumed with `--resume` or `--continue` in another permission mode losing thinking and the prompt cache; one begun in a mode that asks keeps that mode's limits on scripts
entries.zh: 修复了在另一种权限模式下使用`--resume`或`--continue`恢复的代码模式会话丢失思考和提示缓存的问题；以一种模式开始，要求保留该模式对脚本的限制

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode sending a request about every second when a `!` or slash command was typed while a script was running
entries.zh: 修复了在脚本运行时键入`!`或斜杠命令时代码模式大约每秒发送一次请求的问题

entries.en: Fixed an interrupted or failed plugin update leaving a partial plugin folder that later loaded with skills or other components missing (anthropics/claude-code#102186)
entries.zh: 修复了插件更新中断或失败导致部分插件文件夹稍后加载技能或其他组件丢失的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#102186)

entries.en: Fixed Claude failing to read a notebook that has a null output or an error output with no traceback
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德无法读取具有空输出或没有回溯的错误输出的笔记本的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rewind deleting files after a restore had failed
entries.zh: 修复了恢复失败后倒回删除文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed auto mode sometimes refusing Claude's call to stop a /loop, which left the next wake-up to fire
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式有时会拒绝 Claude 停止 /loop 的调用，从而导致下一次唤醒的情况

entries.en: Fixed a Workflow agent's background shells and MCP servers sometimes being left running after it handed back its report
entries.zh: 修复了工作流代理的后台 shell 和 MCP 服务器有时在交回报告后仍然运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin install`, `marketplace add` and similar commands hanging with no output when managed settings needed an approval that could not be asked for
entries.zh: 修复了当托管设置需要无法请求的批准时，`claude plugin install`、`marketplace add`和类似命令挂起且没有输出的问题

entries.en: Fixed a permission rule on a subagent's model, such as `Agent(model:*)`, blocking Claude's follow-up message to a subagent started on this version with no model named
entries.zh: 修复了子代理模型的权限规则，例如`Agent(model:*)`，阻止克劳德向在此版本上启动且没有命名模型的子代理发送后续消息

entries.en: Fixed PermissionRequest hooks not saving `Skill(name:*)` allow rules outside local settings
entries.zh: 修复了 PermissionRequest 挂钩不保存 `Skill(name:*)` 允许本地设置之外的规则的问题

entries.en: Fixed "Ask your admin" asking to raise your own limit when your team's pooled group budget blocked you, and saying "Request sent" when an admin had approved your request in the last few minutes
entries.zh: 修复了当您的团队的集体预算阻止您时，“询问您的管理员”要求提高您自己的限制，并在管理员在过去几分钟内批准您的请求时说“请求已发送”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode losing the middle of a long script output; Claude now gets a path to the uncut text (anthropics/claude-code#111373)
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式丢失长脚本输出的中间部分的问题；克劳德现在获得了未剪切文本的路径（anthropics/claude-code#111373）

entries.en: Fixed hold-to-talk dictation stopping early and losing words when Claude Code was busy
entries.zh: 修复了当克劳德·代码忙碌时，保持通话听写提前停止并丢失单词的问题

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode with `--bare` not telling Claude what its scripts can call
entries.zh: 修复了带有`--bare`的代码模式不告诉 Claude 它的脚本可以调用什么

entries.en: Fixed a crash when a custom API endpoint returned a tool call with no tool name; the call now fails with an error and the session continues
entries.zh: 修复了自定义 API 端点返回没有工具名称的工具调用时崩溃的问题；现在调用因错误而失败，会话继续

entries.en: Fixed the CLI freezing on some replies, and quoted text sometimes going missing or showing twice
entries.zh: 修复了 CLI 冻结某些回复以及引用的文本有时会丢失或显示两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed @-mentions written as `@file#10-12` attaching the whole file instead of those lines
entries.zh: 修复了写为`@file#10-12`的@提及，附加整个文件而不是那些行

entries.en: Fixed Claude misreading a pasted artifact invitation link; it now asks you to accept the invitation and paste the artifact's own link
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德误读粘贴的神器邀请链接的问题；现在它会要求您接受邀请并粘贴工件自己的链接

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands sometimes failing to start on a full temp disk, for sandboxes whose file rules keep commands out of the temp directory
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒 Bash 命令有时无法在完整临时磁盘上启动的问题，因为沙盒的文件规则将命令保留在临时目录之外

entries.en: Windows: Fixed file writes on FAT32 and exFAT drives asking for permission every time in some plugin sessions
entries.zh: Windows：修复了在某些插件会话中每次在 FAT32 和 exFAT 驱动器上写入文件时都会请求许可的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed `/desktop` downloading the older Claude Desktop installer, and asking for an update when an older install's folder was left behind
entries.zh: Windows：修复了`/desktop`下载较旧的 Claude Desktop 安装程序，并在旧安装的文件夹被遗忘时要求更新的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed a possible crash when the machine is almost out of memory
entries.zh: Windows：修复了机器几乎内存不足时可能发生的崩溃

entries.en: Windows: Fixed Claude Code refusing to start when managed settings in the registry contain non-ASCII characters such as Japanese (anthropics/claude-code#93280)
entries.zh: Windows：修复了当注册表中的托管设置包含日语等非 ASCII 字符时 Claude Code 拒绝启动的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#93280)

entries.en: Windows: Fixed Remote Control clients showing no steps for a new subagent
entries.zh: Windows：修复了远程控制客户端不显示新子代理的步骤

entries.en: Windows: Improved the speed of the first Bash command in a session on machines with no custom shell start-up files
entries.zh: Windows：提高了没有自定义 shell 启动文件的计算机上会话中第一个 Bash 命令的速度

entries.en: Windows: Changed start-up with managed settings in the registry: check them before upgrading, as an `HKLM` policy outranks `managed-settings.json` and a broken value can stop the start
entries.zh: Windows：使用注册表中的托管设置更改了启动：在升级之前检查它们，因为`HKLM`策略优先于`managed-settings.json`，并且损坏的值可能会停止启动

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a warning and a link to the revoke page when you log out and the request to revoke your claude.ai login isn't confirmed
entries.zh: [VSCode] 当您注销且撤销 claude.ai 登录请求未得到确认时，添加了警告和指向撤销页面的链接

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a notice before sending a very large selection or attached text file, and advice under "Prompt is too long" that names the large part and what to do next
entries.zh: [VSCode] 在发送非常大的选择或附加文本文件之前添加了一条通知，并在“提示太长”下添加了建议，其中列出了大部分内容以及下一步要做什么

entries.en: [VSCode] Added "Add Cell to Chat" to the notebook cell menu, which attaches a cell with its outputs or error
entries.zh: [VSCode] 在笔记本单元菜单中添加了“将单元添加到聊天”，该菜单附加单元及其输出或错误

entries.en: [VSCode] Added "Fix with Claude Code" as a quick fix for errors and warnings and to failed tests in the test peek and the Test Results view, which puts the problem into the chat box
entries.zh: [VSCode] 添加了“使用 Claude Code 进行修复”作为错误和警告以及测试查看和测试结果视图中失败测试的快速修复，这会将问题放入聊天框中

entries.en: [VSCode] Added "Add to Chat" to the right-click menu of changed files in the Source Control view
entries.zh: [VSCode] 在源代码管理视图中已更改文件的右键菜单中添加了“添加到聊天”

entries.en: [VSCode] Added "Resolve Merge Conflicts" to the editor title of a file with merge conflicts and to the Merge Changes group in Source Control
entries.zh: [VSCode] 将“解决合并冲突”添加到具有合并冲突的文件的编辑器标题以及源代码管理中的“合并更改”组

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed raw tags for selected code under a reworded prompt, the mode button flashing Manual, the slash menu hiding its highlighted row, a broken sign-in image, and a blinking Accept/Reject bar
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在改写提示下所选代码的原始标签、模式按钮闪烁手动、斜杠菜单隐藏其突出显示的行、损坏的登录图像以及闪烁的接受/拒绝栏

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a forked conversation overwriting the original conversation's plan file; a fork or rewind that can't copy the plan now shows a warning
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了分叉对话覆盖原始对话计划文件的问题；无法复制计划的分叉或倒带现在会显示警告

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed voice dictation saying no speech was recognized when its connection closed or never opened; it now says the connection was lost or couldn't connect
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当连接关闭或从未打开时语音听写无法识别语音的问题；现在显示连接已丢失或无法连接

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed an unsent side question being lost when its panel closes
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了面板关闭时未发送的附带问题丢失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Escape stopping Claude after renaming a session, and typing going nowhere after closing the session history with Escape
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Escape 在重命名会话后停止 Claude，以及在使用 Escape 关闭会话历史记录后输入无处可去的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Rename, Mark as Unread and Add to Group saying "still connecting" on a tab that resumed a session from its history
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了从历史记录中恢复会话的选项卡上的重命名、标记为未读和添加到组中显示“仍在连接”的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed wide tables and long paths cut off, long errors hiding their close button, errors out of view in the Add MCP server form and Chrome dialog, and plugin pictures ignoring the editor theme
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了宽表和长路径被切断、隐藏关闭按钮的长错误、添加 MCP 服务器表单和 Chrome 对话框中视图之外的错误以及忽略编辑器主题的插件图片

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed later prompts and the message box covering the Rewind code dialog, and focus jumping from "Never mind" to "Rewind" when it finishes checking files
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了稍后的提示和覆盖“倒带”代码对话框的消息框，以及完成检查文件时焦点从“没关系”跳到“倒带”的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the command menu keeping an earlier match highlighted while you type more in its filter, so Enter could run the wrong row
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当您在过滤器中输入更多内容时，命令菜单会突出显示较早的匹配项，因此 Enter 可能会运行错误的行

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the @ menu showing "No files found" before its first search results arrived, or when it couldn't search all files of a very large workspace, which it now says
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 @ 菜单在第一个搜索结果到达之前或无法搜索非常大的工作区的所有文件时显示“未找到文件”的问题（现在显示为“未找到文件”）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Escape stopping Claude at a Remove or Delete confirmation in MCP, Hooks and Memory dialogs, on a side question panel's button or link, and on the Bookmarks button with its panel open
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Escape 在 MCP、Hooks 和 Memory 对话框、侧面问题面板的按钮或链接以及面板打开的书签按钮上的“删除”或“删除”确认时停止 Claude 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed empty boxes showing instead of the + and − signs in diffs (anthropics/claude-code#73069)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了差异中显示而不是 + 和 − 符号的空框 (anthropics/claude-code#73069)

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the chat no longer following Claude's reply after the panel was resized, or hidden and shown again
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了调整面板大小或隐藏并再次显示后聊天不再关注 Claude 的回复的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a chat left in bypass permissions mode reopening in Auto mode instead of your initial permission mode when settings disable bypass
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当设置禁用旁路时，处于旁路权限模式的聊天会以自动模式而不是初始权限模式重新打开

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the chat panel freezing on some CSS code blocks and diffs
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了聊天面板在某些 CSS 代码块和差异上冻结的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the context usage indicator disappearing after an API error, "Prompt is too long", or a slash command
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 API 错误、“提示太长”或斜杠命令后上下文使用指示器消失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a message queued behind a queued /clear being lost
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在排队/清除后面排队的消息丢失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Manage Plugins losing its search box or showing no message when a search has no match, and not saying that the list of available plugins failed to load
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了管理插件丢失搜索框或在搜索不匹配时不显示任何消息，并且未提示可用插件列表加载失败的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed proposed changes to notebooks and files with a custom editor opening in a tab with no Accept or Reject that stayed open after the answer
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了对笔记本和文件的建议更改，其中自定义编辑器在选项卡中打开，没有“接受”或“拒绝”，在答案后保持打开状态

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the spend limit message telling Team and Enterprise members to run `/usage-credits`, which can't send a request to their admin from the panel
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了告诉团队和企业成员运行`/usage-credits`的支出限制消息，该消息无法从面板向管理员发送请求

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a written message being wiped by Tab on a command in the "/" button's menu or by a click on an onboarding suggestion
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了通过“/”按钮菜单中的命令上的 Tab 或单击入门建议来擦除书面消息的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Claude continuing to edit files after you rewind code while it is working
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在代码运行时回退后克劳德继续编辑文件的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed typed text being lost after /tasks, /copy, /export, a skipped /feedback, or /plan while already in plan mode
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在已处于计划模式时在 /tasks、/copy、/export、跳过的 /feedback 或 /plan 后丢失的键入文本

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the question card dropping a typed "Other" answer on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, and sending the word "Other" when nothing was typed
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了问题卡在 Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 上输入“其他”答案时会丢失问题，并在未输入任何内容时发送“其他”一词的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the panel showing "Something went wrong" for a conversation in which a gateway sent a tool call with no name
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了网关发送无名称工具调用的对话中显示“出现问题”的面板

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed unsaved changes being missed, and Claude's edit being overwritten by the next save, in a folder opened through a symlink
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了通过符号链接打开的文件夹中未保存的更改被遗漏，以及 Claude 的编辑被下一次保存覆盖的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed @-mentions attaching nothing, or another file of the same name, after Claude changed folders with `cd`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Claude 使用`cd`更改文件夹后，@-mentions 不附加任何内容或附加同名文件的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the arrow keys replacing typed text with an old prompt while selecting, and dropping edits to a recalled prompt
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了选择时箭头键用旧提示替换键入的文本以及对调用的提示进行编辑的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed an @-mention added while a permission prompt was open being lost
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在权限提示打开时添加的 @-mention 丢失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed shortcuts such as Ctrl+1, Alt+1 or Ctrl+Space answering an open dialog, which could restore files in the rewind confirmation or switch the git branch
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Ctrl+1、Alt+1 或 Ctrl+Space 等快捷键应答打开对话框的问题，可在回退确认中恢复文件或切换 git 分支

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed prompts that start with a file path or code comment being sent without the selected code and having no fork or rewind menu
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了以文件路径或代码注释开头的提示，在没有选定代码的情况下发送，并且没有分叉或倒带菜单

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed file links in the chat ignoring your editor associations for files in the workspace, except notebooks (anthropics/claude-code#81482)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了聊天中的文件链接，忽略工作区中文件的编辑器关联，笔记本除外 (anthropics/claude-code#81482)

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed selected lines staying attached to your next message after their file's tab was closed
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了选定的行在文件选项卡关闭后仍附加到下一条消息的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed new sessions starting in Edit automatically after pressing Shift+Tab through it to reach Plan mode
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了按 Shift+Tab 进入计划模式后自动在编辑中启动的新会话

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed an edited command on the permission prompt running without the line breaks that were typed or pasted into it
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在运行权限提示时编辑的命令没有键入或粘贴到其中的换行符

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a newly opened Claude tab not focusing its message box, or taking the keyboard late from the terminal or command palette and sending the typed text as a prompt
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了新打开的 Claude 选项卡未聚焦其消息框，或者较晚从终端或命令面板使用键盘并发送键入的文本作为提示的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Alt+K line ranges such as `@app.ts#5-10` sending the whole file, or its first 2,000 lines, instead of the selected lines
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Alt+K 行范围，例如 `@app.ts#5-10` 发送整个文件或其前 2,000 行，而不是选定的行

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed diff tabs opening out of order when several subagents wait for approval, and a later edit to the same file cancelling an earlier one
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当多个子代理等待批准时差异选项卡打开顺序不正确的问题，以及稍后对同一文件的编辑会取消之前的编辑

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Enter rewriting a message or running a menu action when a `/word` such as the path `/api` stands beside other text, and running a typed slash command without its arguments
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当`/word`（例如路径`/api`）位于其他文本旁边并运行不带参数的键入斜杠命令时，Enter 重写消息或运行菜单操作的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Electron apps and extension tests failing to start from Claude, a hook or an MCP server; a wrapper, hook or server that runs VS Code as Node must now set `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Electron 应用程序和扩展测试无法从 Claude、钩子或 MCP 服务器启动的问题；作为节点运行 VS Code 的包装器、挂钩或服务器现在必须设置`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Claude not being told when you reject part of a proposed edit or change it in the diff view before accepting
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当您拒绝部分建议编辑或在接受之前在 diff 视图中更改它时 Claude 不会被告知的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Escape on a permission prompt sending a half-typed instruction to Claude instead of cancelling
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了权限提示中的 Escape 向 Claude 发送半输入指令而不是取消的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+J and Ctrl+O in the chat also opening VS Code's terminal or Open File dialog on Windows and Linux
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了聊天中的 Ctrl+J 和 Ctrl+O 在 Windows 和 Linux 上也会打开 VS Code 的终端或“打开文件”对话框的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the @ menu inserting the wrong file on a quick Tab or Enter, and Enter not sending a prompt that ends in an @word with no matching file
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 @ 菜单在快速 Tab 或 Enter 上插入错误文件，并且 Enter 不发送以 @word 结尾且没有匹配文件的提示

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed new Claude tabs staying blank and the side bar failing to load after closing a tab while Claude was still starting
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了新的 Claude 选项卡保持空白以及在 Claude 仍在启动时关闭选项卡后侧边栏无法加载的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a quick double click in the panel pressing a button or row that appeared after the first click, or starting a second compaction from the context usage circle
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在面板中快速双击按下第一次单击后出现的按钮或行，或从上下文使用圈开始第二次压缩的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed switching models failing with "Settings file is not valid JSON" when settings.json is empty or starts with a byte order mark
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当 settings.json 为空或以字节顺序标记开头时，切换模型失败并显示“设置文件不是有效的 JSON”的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed memory growing with each fork or rewind of a long conversation until the window was reloaded
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了内存随着每次分叉或回退长对话而增长的问题，直到重新加载窗口

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed plan comments not showing on the plan approval card in Focus view
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了焦点视图中计划审批卡上未显示计划注释的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed file links without a line number moving the cursor of an open file to line 1
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了没有行号的文件链接将打开文件的光标移动到第 1 行的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a missing notification when a conversation running behind another one in the same panel needs a permission or an answer
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当同一面板中另一个对话后面运行的对话需要权限或答案时丢失通知的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Manage Plugins not loading when Claude Code is slow to start or fails to start, so a plugin that blocks startup can be turned off
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Claude Code 启动缓慢或启动失败时 Manage Plugins 无法加载的问题，因此可以关闭阻止启动的插件

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed proposed diffs showing and saving garbled non-ASCII text when `files.encoding` is not UTF-8
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当`files.encoding`不是 UTF-8 时显示和保存乱码非 ASCII 文本的建议差异

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed approved edits and writes saving right-to-left marks as literal `\u200F` escapes on lines with Hebrew, Arabic or Persian text
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了批准的编辑和写入，将从右到左的标记保存为希伯来语、阿拉伯语或波斯语文本行上的文字`\u200F`转义符

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a model pick being ignored for the next message when Claude's process had ended or was still starting
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当 Claude 的进程结束或仍在启动时，下一条消息的模型选择被忽略的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Rewind showing "No active session" after Claude's process had ended
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Claude 进程结束后倒带显示“没有活动会话”的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed typing @ leaving a helper process running per tab when no browser is connected, except when Claude in Chrome's service can't be reached
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在未连接浏览器时键入 @ 让每个选项卡运行的帮助程序进程的问题，除非无法访问 Chrome 服务中的 Claude

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list opening every transcript at once, which stalled the editor's extensions and could leave sessions out in projects with many sessions
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了会话列表一次打开每个记录的问题，这会阻止编辑器的扩展，并且可能会在具有多个会话的项目中遗漏会话

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved the time to the first reply in a new folder when the Python extension is installed and the folder has no Python
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进了安装了 Python 扩展且文件夹中没有 Python 时在新文件夹中第一次回复的时间

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved the sign-in screen to say when it opened because a request was refused
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进了登录屏幕，以显示由于请求被拒绝而打开的时间

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved the speed of opening, restoring and switching back to long conversations, most of all with many file edits or where git is slow
entries.zh: [VSCode] 提高了打开、恢复和切换回长对话的速度，尤其是在编辑大量文件或 git 速度较慢的情况下

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved responsiveness in long chats: smooth typing and large file writes while a reply streams, faster permission prompts, and far less freezing on send with accessibility support on
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进了长时间聊天中的响应能力：在回复流时流畅打字和大文件写入、更快的权限提示以及通过辅助功能支持减少发送时的冻结情况

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved startup and memory use: the panel and new chat tabs open faster, a first message in a new tab is answered sooner, and on Pro and Max plans the folder trust dialog comes up sooner
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进了启动和内存使用：面板和新聊天选项卡打开速度更快，新选项卡中的第一条消息得到更快回复，在 Pro 和 Max 计划中，文件夹信任对话框更快出现

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved speed in remote windows (SSH, WSL, containers): the panel starts, replies appear and sessions reopen faster
entries.zh: [VSCode] 提高了远程窗口（SSH、WSL、容器）的速度：面板启动、回复显示以及会话重新打开速度更快

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved the time to a response for the first message after a chat has been idle for a few minutes on a machine that is low on memory
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进了在内存不足的计算机上聊天闲置几分钟后响应第一条消息的时间

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved how fast chats start, open from history and come back after a restart on slow or antivirus-scanned disks
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进了在慢速磁盘或经过防病毒扫描的磁盘上聊天启动、从历史记录中打开以及重新启动后返回的速度

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved how fast diffs appear in reopened conversations, and removed diff menu entries that did not work
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进了重新打开的对话中差异显示的速度，并删除了不起作用的差异菜单条目

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved the @ file menu to list the files of open editor tabs first, the most recently used on top
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进了@文件菜单，首先列出打开的编辑器选项卡的文件，最近使用的位于顶部

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed saving a proposed diff to accept it only after you click or type in its proposed (right) side; a notification says when a save is refused or a close with Save applies nothing
entries.zh: [VSCode] 更改了保存建议的差异，仅在您单击或输入其建议的（右侧）侧后才接受它；一条通知显示，当保存被拒绝或使用“保存”关闭时，不会执行任何操作

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed diffs from a terminal session to open without moving keyboard focus, and beside a file with unsaved changes; to answer, click Accept or use the terminal
entries.zh: [VSCode] 将终端会话中的差异更改为在不移动键盘焦点的情况下打开，并位于未保存更改的文件旁边；要回答，请单击“接受”或使用终端

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed permission cards to show only Yes and No when `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` is set and the card would offer an allow rule; key 2 on those cards now answers No
entries.zh: [VSCode] 更改了权限卡，使其在设置了`allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`并且卡将提供允许规则时仅显示“是”和“否”；这些卡上的键 2 现在回答“否”

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed a Claude tab to ignore Enter and show a notice when its Find box has lost the keyboard
entries.zh: [VSCode] 更改了 Claude 选项卡以忽略 Enter 并在其查找框丢失键盘时显示通知

entries.en: Added sign-in to organizations managed in Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console: after `claude auth login`, Claude Code applies the organization's settings and uses its cloud provider or gateway
entries.zh: 添加了对在 Anthropic 企业管理控制台中管理的组织的登录：在`claude auth login`之后，Claude Code 应用组织的设置并使用其云提供商或网关

entries.en: Added easel, a built-in mod that draws charts when asked and under MCP metrics results, on Pro, Max and, where available, Team and Enterprise on macOS and Linux; turn automatic charts off in `/config`
entries.zh: 添加了画架，这是一个内置模块，可在询问时在 MCP 指标结果下绘制图表，适用于 macOS 和 Linux 上的 Pro、Max 以及可用的 Team 和 Enterprise；在`/config`中关闭自动图表

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_FULL_SIGN_IN_LINK=1` to print the full sign-in link, if the short one shows an error or a script reads values from it
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_FULL_SIGN_IN_LINK=1`以打印完整的登录链接（如果短链接显示错误或脚本从中读取值）

entries.en: Added a notice in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions when a plugin marketplace can't be fetched because its repository isn't one of the session's
entries.zh: 当无法获取插件市场时，在云和自托管运行器会话中添加了一条通知，因为它的存储库不是会话的存储库之一

entries.en: Added `commandPrinted` to `claude plugin install --json` results, true when the plugin's install command wrote to stderr, and `commandFailed` when it exited with an error, was killed or timed out
entries.zh: 在`claude plugin install --json`结果中添加了`commandPrinted`，当插件的安装命令写入 stderr 时为 true，当插件因错误退出、被终止或超时时添加`commandFailed`

entries.en: Added `claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_registered_seconds` to the self-hosted runner's `/metrics`: seconds from work order issued to registration accepted, on orchestrator-spawned runners
entries.zh: 将`claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_registered_seconds`添加到自托管运行器的`/metrics`：在协调器生成的运行器上，从发出工作订单到接受注册的秒数

entries.en: Added `claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_first_session_seconds` to the self-hosted runner's `/metrics`: seconds from work order to first session handed over, on runners started for a session
entries.zh: 将`claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_first_session_seconds`添加到自托管运行器的`/metrics`：在开始会话的运行器上，从工作订单到移交的第一个会话的秒数

entries.en: Improved the claude.ai sign-in link shown by /login, `claude auth login` and `claude setup-token`: it is now much shorter
entries.zh: 改进了 /login、`claude auth login` 和 `claude setup-token` 显示的 claude.ai 登录链接：现在更短了

entries.en: Improved the speed of file diffs
entries.zh: 提高了文件差异的速度

entries.en: Improved `/config` search: most settings whose name starts with what you type come first, "effort" finds Model, and "dark" or "light" finds Theme
entries.zh: 改进了`/config`搜索：名称以您键入的内容开头的大多数设置都排在前面，“effort”查找模型，“dark”或“light”查找主题

entries.en: Improved `/resume`: sessions where you only opened a screen such as `/model` and left are no longer listed
entries.zh: 改进了`/resume`：仅打开`/model`等屏幕并离开的会话不再列出

entries.en: Improved Reconnect in `/mcp` and `/plugin`: a server's page now stays open, with the cause in view, when the server still fails or needs sign-in
entries.zh: 改进了`/mcp`和`/plugin`中的重新连接：当服务器仍然失败或需要登录时，服务器页面现在保持打开状态，并可查看原因

entries.en: Improved the error on macOS when sandbox deny lists are too long: it now names the long lists and how to shorten them
entries.zh: 改进了 macOS 上沙箱拒绝列表太长时出现的错误：现在命名长列表以及如何缩短它们

entries.en: Improved `/plugin` in fullscreen mode: the page of a plugin with errors now starts with those errors
entries.zh: 改进了全屏模式下的`/plugin`：有错误的插件页面现在以这些错误开头

entries.en: Improved `/ultrareview`'s cost confirmation on Team and Enterprise plans: it now says how much of your monthly spend limit is left when that is less than a review usually costs
entries.zh: 改进了`/ultrareview`对团队和企业计划的成本确认：现在，当低于审查通常的成本时，它会显示您的每月支出限额还剩多少

entries.en: Improved self-hosted runner sessions on Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud's Agent Platform to say so when they start on another default model because your account refused the first
entries.zh: 改进了 Amazon Bedrock 或 Google Cloud 代理平台上的自托管运行器会话，当它们在另一个默认模型上启动时会这样说，因为您的帐户拒绝了第一个模型

entries.en: Improved Code Mode: Claude is now told how to look at images and PDFs
entries.zh: 改进的代码模式：Claude 现在被告知如何查看图像和 PDF

entries.en: Improved Code Mode: after Esc, "Interrupted" now shows under the stopped command in place of a red error
entries.zh: 改进的代码模式：Esc 后，“已中断”现在显示在停止的命令下，而不是红色错误

entries.en: Improved Code Mode: the terminal freezes for far less time after a subagent's script makes thousands of tool calls
entries.zh: 改进的代码模式：在子代理的脚本进行数千次工具调用后，终端冻结的时间要少得多

entries.en: Changed recurring scheduled tasks and `/loop` to run up to 30 days instead of 7 while their session keeps running, and say when they end; tasks made before this release still end at 7 days
entries.zh: 将重复计划任务和`/loop`更改为运行长达 30 天而不是 7 天，同时会话继续运行，并说明何时结束；在此版本之前完成的任务仍将在 7 天后结束

entries.en: Changed more `rm` commands aimed at the root, home, a top-level folder or the working folder to ask for approval; where nobody can answer, they're refused
entries.zh: 更改了更多针对根目录、主目录、顶级文件夹或工作文件夹的 `rm` 命令以请求批准；没有人能回答的地方，他们就被拒绝了

entries.en: Changed `deniedMcpServers` name entries to hide only the named claude.ai connector, not others at its URL; to block them all, deny its exact URL
entries.zh: 更改了`deniedMcpServers`名称条目，以仅隐藏指定的 claude.ai 连接器，而不隐藏其 URL 上的其他连接器；要阻止所有这些内容，请拒绝其确切的 URL

entries.en: Changed `claude --teleport` in some setups to print the git commands for switching branch instead of running them; with `-p` it exits 1 until you switch
entries.zh: 在某些设置中更改了`claude --teleport`以打印用于切换分支的 git 命令而不是运行它们；使用 `-p` 它将退出 1 直到您切换

entries.en: Changed unrecognized model names containing "sonnet" or "haiku" to use the shorter system prompt, like other unrecognized names; `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=0` gives every model the full one
entries.zh: 更改了包含“sonnet”或“haiku”的无法识别的模型名称，以使用更短的系统提示符，就像其他无法识别的名称一样； `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=0` 为每个模型提供完整的模型

entries.en: Changed skills that Claude runs with a `model` setting, other than `context: fork` skills, to leave subagents, forks, compaction and `/recap` on the session's model
entries.zh: 更改了克劳德使用“模型”设置运行的技能，而不是“上下文：分叉”技能，以在会话模型上保留子代理、分叉、压缩和`/recap`

entries.en: Changed a subagent's model fallback to carry over: agents with no model and forks it then starts run on the fallback, and the agents they start use its Bedrock region
entries.zh: 更改了子代理的模型回退以保留：没有模型的代理并分叉它然后开始在回退上运行，并且它们开始使用其基岩区域的代理

entries.en: Changed self-hosted runners to stop a session's start at once, without trying other runners, when a checkout hook exits with status 108
entries.zh: 更改了自托管运行程序，当签出挂钩以状态 108 退出时，立即停止会话的启动，而不尝试其他运行程序

entries.en: Changed prompt hooks to accept model aliases such as `haiku` or `sonnet` in their `model` field
entries.zh: 更改了提示挂钩以在`model`字段中接受模型别名，例如`haiku`或`sonnet`

entries.en: Changed `/design-sync`'s fallback build of the reference Storybook to use only a Storybook installed in the project
entries.zh: 更改了参考 Storybook 的`/design-sync`后备版本，以仅使用项目中安装的 Storybook

entries.en: Changed subagent progress summaries in terminal sessions signed in to a Claude apps gateway to be written from short notes instead of the whole conversation, using far fewer tokens
entries.zh: 更改了登录到克劳德应用程序网关的终端会话中的子代理进度摘要，以使用更少的令牌从简短的注释而不是整个对话中编写

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code freezing for up to several minutes right after compacting a very long conversation
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德代码在压缩很长的对话后冻结长达几分钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch freezing the session for minutes on some pages, and returning an empty result for some others
entries.zh: 修复了 WebFetch 在某些页面上冻结会话几分钟，并为其他一些页面返回空结果的问题

entries.en: Fixed `ExitWorktree` and the worktree exit dialog deleting a worktree that another running Claude Code session was working in
entries.zh: 修复了`ExitWorktree`和工作树退出对话框删除另一个正在运行的克劳德代码会话正在其中工作的工作树

entries.en: Fixed changes to user settings being lost when several Claude Code processes saved them at the same time
entries.zh: 修复了当多个 Claude Code 进程同时保存用户设置更改时丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--continue` and `--resume` opening an empty session or failing when the last saved message had a missing or invalid timestamp
entries.zh: 修复了`--continue`和`--resume`打开空会话或在上次保存的消息丢失或无效时间戳时失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed the first prompt after a sleep of two minutes or more waiting three minutes on a connection that had died, on Linux and WSL
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 和 WSL 上在已断开的连接上休眠两分钟或更长时间等待三分钟后的第一个提示

entries.en: Fixed turns failing with "JSON schema is invalid", and session files growing by many megabytes, when many MCP tools have an input schema that the API refuses
entries.zh: 修复了当许多 MCP 工具具有 API 拒绝的输入模式时，由于“JSON 模式无效”而失败以及会话文件增长许多兆字节的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/rewind` sometimes restoring an older version of a file when two queued prompts, or stacked skills, ran together right after a turn that changed it
entries.zh: 修复了当两个排队提示或堆叠技能在更改文件的回合后立即运行在一起时，`/rewind`有时会恢复文件的旧版本

entries.en: Fixed text and images added when approving a permission prompt being dropped when the approved command or tool then failed
entries.zh: 修复了批准权限提示时添加的文本和图像在批准的命令或工具失败时被删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP resources from claude.ai connectors and plugin servers not being attached when @-mentioned in the terminal's prompt box
entries.zh: 修复了在终端提示框中@提及时未附加来自 claude.ai 连接器和插件服务器的 MCP 资源的问题

entries.en: Fixed an MCP server that subagents declare being shut down when one of them finished, while other subagents or the session were still using it
entries.zh: 修复了一个 MCP 服务器，当其中一个子代理完成时，子代理会声明关闭，而其他子代理或会话仍在使用它

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome staying "not connected" after a brief connection problem, even though Chrome was open and signed in
entries.zh: 修复了 Chrome 中的 Claude 在短暂连接问题后保持“未连接”状态，即使 Chrome 已打开并登录

entries.en: Fixed terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock (Mantle) started with no model selected ignoring a pinned Opus model, and still calling an unavailable default model after announcing a fallback
entries.zh: 修复了 Amazon Bedrock (Mantle) 上的终端会话在启动时未选择任何模型的情况，忽略固定的 Opus 模型，并且在宣布回退后仍然调用不可用的默认模型

entries.en: Fixed the rest of what you were typing being lost when a plan arrived in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了当计划进入全屏模式时您输入的其余内容丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed claude.ai connectors with different names being dropped when they share a server URL (anthropics/claude-code#101856)
entries.zh: 修复了共享服务器 URL 时删除具有不同名称的 claude.ai 连接器的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#101856)

entries.en: Fixed plugins going missing from the installed list when several `claude plugin` commands ran at the same time
entries.zh: 修复了当多个`claude plugin`命令同时运行时插件从已安装列表中丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed task dependencies and metadata being lost when several task updates ran at the same time
entries.zh: 修复了同时运行多个任务更新时任务依赖性和元数据丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed incomplete backups of `~/.claude.json` being kept, and displacing good ones, when the disk was full
entries.zh: 修复了当磁盘已满时保留的`~/.claude.json`的不完整备份，并替换了好的备份

entries.en: Fixed a long pause in Code Mode after code that read hundreds of files in projects with path-scoped rules or Read deny rules
entries.zh: 修复了使用路径范围规则或读取拒绝规则读取项目中数百个文件的代码后代码模式中的长时间暂停

entries.en: Fixed the built-in chart tool failing when Claude called it in Code Mode
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德在代码模式下调用内置图表工具时失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode ignoring an MCP tool's request to end the turn from a script in auto and bypass permissions modes
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式忽略 MCP 工具在自动和绕过权限模式下结束脚本轮次的请求

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode in auto mode dropping earlier thinking and rewriting the prompt cache when a mod added a note after a script loaded a skill
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式下的代码模式，当模组在脚本加载技能后添加注释时，会放弃早期思考并重写提示缓存

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode not restoring a file that a script had read after Esc and `/compact`
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式不恢复脚本在 Esc 和 `/compact` 之后读取的文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/context` undercounting system tools in Code Mode before Claude's first reply
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德第一次回复之前在代码模式下`/context`低估系统工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed a stopped background subagent sometimes not staying stopped
entries.zh: 修复了停止的后台子代理有时不会保持停止状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude still waiting for a background agent that was stopped just as it finished, in sessions run by an app or the SDK
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 仍在等待后台代理，该代理在应用程序或 SDK 运行的会话中刚完成就停止的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions sometimes waking in their previous permission mode after approving a plan
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话有时会在批准计划后以之前的权限模式唤醒的问题

entries.en: Fixed environment variables written by a SessionStart hook being lost with `claude -p --continue`
entries.zh: 修复了 SessionStart 挂钩写入的环境变量因`claude -p --continue`而丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 with no message when its output went to a file on a full disk: it now prints an error and exits 1, though a full NFS export may go unnoticed
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p`在输出到完整磁盘上的文件时退出 0 且没有任何消息的问题：它现在打印错误并退出 1，尽管完整的 NFS 导出可能会被忽视

entries.en: Fixed the system prompt keeping the earlier model's instructions when the model was changed after `/context` but before the first message
entries.zh: 修复了在`/context`之后但在第一条消息之前更改模型时系统提示保留早期模型的说明的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude sometimes replying to its commit attribution reminder and ending the turn early after the model changed mid-turn; it can still happen where managed settings set the PR attribution line
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德有时会回复其提交归因提醒并在模型中途更改后提前结束回合的问题；在托管设置设置 PR 归因线的情况下，这种情况仍然可能发生

entries.en: Fixed Esc not ending an LSP tool call that was waiting for a slow or stuck language server
entries.zh: 修复了 Esc 未结束等待缓慢或卡住的语言服务器的 LSP 工具调用的问题

entries.en: Fixed LSP tool calls and diagnostics failing when several calls or edits arrived while a language server was still starting
entries.zh: 修复了语言服务器仍在启动时多次调用或编辑到达时 LSP 工具调用和诊断失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp` listing plugin servers as built-in: they now stand under "Plugin MCPs", `--mcp-config` and built-in servers under "Other MCPs", and a server's page names its plugin
entries.zh: 修复了`/mcp`将插件服务器列为内置的问题：它们现在位于“插件 MCP”下，`--mcp-config`和内置服务器位于“其他 MCP”下，并且服务器的页面为其插件命名

entries.en: Fixed an "MCP server blocked by enterprise policy: easel" warning showing at every start when an MCP allowlist or denylist excludes the built-in chart tool, which stays blocked
entries.zh: 修复了当 MCP 允许列表或拒绝列表排除内置图表工具（该工具始终被阻止）时，每次启动时都会显示“MCP 服务器被企业策略阻止：画架”警告

entries.en: Fixed `/stats` counting new activity in UTC days instead of your local time zone
entries.zh: 修复了`/stats`以 UTC 日而不是本地时区计算新活动的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` failing or reviewing the wrong code after the shell moved into another repository: it now stops and names both folders
entries.zh: 修复了 shell 移入另一个存储库后`/ultrareview`失败或检查错误代码的问题：它现在停止并命名两个文件夹

entries.en: Fixed Grep reporting no matches when the pattern held a line break without multiline mode; it now reports the rejected pattern
entries.zh: 修复了当模式在没有多行模式的情况下存在换行符时 Grep 报告没有匹配项的问题；它现在报告被拒绝的模式

entries.en: Fixed Jupyter notebooks saved with a byte order mark being reported as invalid JSON by the Read and NotebookEdit tools
entries.zh: 修复了使用字节顺序标记保存的 Jupyter 笔记本被 Read 和 NotebookEdit 工具报告为无效 JSON 的问题

entries.en: Fixed link reference definitions being dropped from CLAUDE.md and memory files that contain an HTML comment
entries.zh: 修复了从 CLAUDE.md 和包含 HTML 注释的内存文件中删除的链接引用定义

entries.en: Fixed running Monitors keeping the earlier conversation in memory until they end
entries.zh: 修复了正在运行的监视器将先前的对话保留在内存中直到结束

entries.en: Fixed some Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers, other than scheduled tasks, ending a turn with "Prompt is too long" when a PDF larger than the context window followed a long conversation
entries.zh: 修复了除计划任务之外的第三方提供商上的一些 Claude Desktop 会话，当长时间对话后出现大于上下文窗口的 PDF 时，以“提示太长”结束回合

entries.en: Fixed the choice between two user or project agent files declaring the same name depending on the order the file search listed them
entries.zh: 修复了声明相同名称的两个用户或项目代理文件之间的选择，具体取决于文件搜索列出它们的顺序

entries.en: Fixed `claude daemon logs` never exiting inside a git repository when there is no log file
entries.zh: 修复了当没有日志文件时“claude daemon messages”永远不会在 git 存储库中退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed markdown hiding a character or two after bold or italic text when a backslash came before an emoji later in the paragraph
entries.zh: 修复了当反斜杠出现在段落后面的表情符号之前时，Markdown 在粗体或斜体文本后隐藏一两个字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed Edit refusing some valid hook commands in Claude settings files
entries.zh: 修复了编辑拒绝克劳德设置文件中的某些有效挂钩命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed `Read` with a page range showing both halves of a scanned two-page spread on each of its pages
entries.zh: 修复了“阅读”的页面范围，在每个页面上显示扫描的两页跨页的两半

entries.en: Fixed line breaks and class stereotypes missing from Mermaid diagrams in HTML artifacts
entries.zh: 修复了 HTML 工件中美人鱼图中缺少的换行符和类刻板印象

entries.en: Fixed the Project instructions picker in `/config` showing only one of its four choices in a 24-row fullscreen window
entries.zh: 修复了`/config`中的项目指令选择器在 24 行全屏窗口中仅显示四个选项之一

entries.en: Fixed a subagent's own subagents and forks running on the plan-mode model in plan mode under `opusplan` or `haiku`
entries.zh: 修复了在`opusplan`或`haiku`下的计划模式下在计划模式模型上运行的子代理自己的子代理和分支

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch page summaries ignoring the `/effort` level when a gateway refuses the small fast model
entries.zh: 修复了当网关拒绝小型快速模型时 WebFetch 页面摘要忽略`/effort`级别的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` on Google Cloud's Agent Platform ignoring `--settings '{"fastMode":true}'` when the model comes from `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` or a settings file; such runs now bill at the fast mode price
entries.zh: 修复了当模型来自`ANTHROPIC_MODEL`或设置文件时，Google Cloud 代理平台上的`claude -p`忽略`--settings '{"fastMode":true}'`；此类运行现在按快速模式价格计费

entries.en: Fixed startup under `forceLoginOrgUUID` being refused after one temporary server error or dropped connection
entries.zh: 修复了`forceLoginOrgUUID`下的启动在一次临时服务器错误或断开连接后被拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp remove` giving no way forward for a claude.ai connector: it now says to turn it off in /mcp or remove it on claude.ai
entries.zh: 修复了`claude mcp remove`无法为 claude.ai 连接器提供前进方向的问题：它现在表示在 /mcp 中将其关闭或在 claude.ai 上将其删除

entries.en: Fixed the /mcp "Connect on claude.ai" check saying "not connected" when claude.ai has a connector at the server's URL without its query
entries.zh: 修复了当 claude.ai 在服务器 URL 上有连接器而没有查询时，/mcp“在 claude.ai 上连接”检查显示“未连接”

entries.en: Fixed `/install-github-app` and `/design-login` showing a generic failure for an account on hold instead of the on-hold notice and appeal link
entries.zh: 修复了`/install-github-app`和`/design-login`显示帐户暂停的一般失败，而不是暂停通知和申诉链接

entries.en: Fixed a running MCP task being reported as stopped when you move a session to the background; the background session can now follow the task, but not if its server uses stdio or sets headers
entries.zh: 修复了当您将会话移至后台时，正在运行的 MCP 任务被报告为已停止的问题；后台会话现在可以跟踪任务，但如果其服务器使用 stdio 或设置标头则不能

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runners ignoring a session until they exited, after its failure report was lost or the session was given back to the same runner
entries.zh: 修复了自托管运行器在失败报告丢失或会话返回给同一运行器后忽略会话直至退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted sessions losing the prompt cache and earlier thinking when the list of repositories a restart couldn't prepare changed
entries.zh: 修复了自托管会话在重新启动无法准备更改的存储库列表时丢失提示缓存和早期思考的问题

entries.en: Fixed resumed self-hosted runner sessions starting without their pushed work in large repositories when `--push-outcome-on-release` is set
entries.zh: 修复了设置`--push-outcome-on-release`时，在大型存储库中没有推送工作的情况下恢复的自托管运行器会话开始的问题

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions being shown as working when Claude Code hangs at every start and `--startup-timeout-min` is from 2 to about 6
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude Code 在每次启动时挂起并且`--startup-timeout-min`从 2 到大约 6 时，自托管运行器会话显示为正在运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `pkill -f` in self-hosted runner sessions on Linux ending its own shell with exit code 144, or the runner (needs a `pkill` with `--ignore-ancestors`)
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上自托管运行程序会话中的`pkill -f`，以退出代码 144 结束自己的 shell，或运行程序（需要带有`--ignore-ancestors`的`pkill`）

entries.en: Fixed scheduled tasks on self-hosted runners having no tool to notify their owner when telemetry is off or a third-party provider is used
entries.zh: 修复了自托管运行器上的计划任务，在遥测关闭或使用第三方提供商时没有工具通知其所有者

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runners' warn mode for repository settings stopping at the first finding of most kinds: it now goes on, up to 50 for a session, and says if it stops early
entries.zh: 修复了自托管运行程序的存储库设置在大多数类型的第一个发现时停止的警告模式：现在它会继续，每次会话最多 50 个，并表示是否提前停止

entries.en: Fixed the self-hosted runner's `last_poll_age_seconds` reading 0 while the runner had never polled successfully
entries.zh: 修复了自托管运行程序从未成功轮询时其`last_poll_age_seconds`读数为 0 的问题

entries.en: Fixed the notice about a skipped scheduled task that names no organization: it now says to start Claude Code with `--resume`, because `/resume` inside a running session doesn't run the task
entries.zh: 修复了有关跳过未命名组织的计划任务的通知：它现在说用`--resume`启动 Claude Code，因为正在运行的会话中的`/resume`不会运行该任务

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` wrongly warning that a mod's `AbovePrompt` or `AbovePromptList` hook never runs in VS Code
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin validate`错误地警告 mod 的`AbovePrompt`或`AbovePromptList`挂钩永远不会在 VS Code 中运行

entries.en: Fixed `/design-sync` deleting a file it had just uploaded when Claude Design stored that file under a changed name
entries.zh: 修复了`/design-sync`在 Claude Design 以更改的名称存储该文件时删除刚刚上传的文件的问题

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Added `--start-dir` / `SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_START_DIR` to have Claude start its work in a folder of a repository, while settings and hooks load as without it
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：添加了 `--start-dir` / `SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_START_DIR` 以使 Claude 在存储库的文件夹中开始其工作，而设置和挂钩加载就像没有它一样

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Added a notice when Anthropic-managed git refuses a plugin's own repository, naming the plugin and what to do
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：添加了当 Anthropic 管理的 git 拒绝插件自己的存储库时的通知、命名插件以及执行操作

entries.en: Linux: Fixed Bash commands waiting seconds and showing no file diff for the rest of a session in slow repositories with large ignored folders such as `node_modules`
entries.zh: Linux：修复了 Bash 命令等待几秒钟并在具有大型被忽略文件夹（例如`node_modules`）的慢速存储库中在会话的其余部分中不显示文件差异的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed Bash commands running slower for the rest of a session after Git Bash took 10 to 60 seconds to start, on machines with no custom start-up files
entries.zh: Windows：修复了在没有自定义启动文件的计算机上 Git Bash 需要 10 到 60 秒启动后，Bash 命令在会话的剩余时间内运行速度变慢的问题

entries.en: Remote Control: Fixed the note about background agents ended by a Stop from a phone or the web showing in the terminal as if you had typed it
entries.zh: 远程控制：修复了有关后台代理的注释，该注释以手机或网络中的“停止”结尾，显示在终端中，就好像您已键入该注释一样

entries.en: Remote Control: Fixed the mobile apps hiding the Diff and pull request buttons, or showing a stopped session as working, after turning it on mid-conversation
entries.zh: 远程控制：修复了移动应用程序在对话中打开后隐藏 Diff 和拉取请求按钮，或将已停止的会话显示为正在运行的问题

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed tool calls behind a permission prompt vanishing with no result when a new runner took over the prompt, in sessions with telemetry off
entries.zh: 自托管运行程序：修复了在遥测关闭的会话中，当新运行程序接管提示时，权限提示后面的工具调用消失而没有结果的问题

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed one slow `spawn-runner` hook keeping the orchestrator from claiming sessions for its free slots; it now polls every 4 to 6 seconds while a slot is free
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了一个缓慢的`spawn-runner`钩子，使协调器无法为其空闲插槽声明会话；现在，当插槽空闲时，它每 4 到 6 秒轮询一次

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a 403, such as an IP allowlist's, logged as a bad secret or token: most such lines now lead with the server's reason, so update log alerts that match the old words
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了 403，例如 IP 白名单，记录为错误的秘密或令牌：大多数此类行现在都以服务器原因开头，因此请更新与旧单词匹配的日志警报

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed runners that start on a full disk taking sessions and failing them; they now wait for room and exit 1 after a minute with no session, unless started from a work order
entries.zh: 自托管运行程序：修复了在完整磁盘上启动并进行会话并失败的运行程序；他们现在等待房间并在一分钟后退出 1，没有会话，除非从工作订单开始

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a failed start suggesting a retry when the runner's machine had no git credentials; the error now says whom to ask and what to do if the repository is wrong
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了当运行器的计算机没有 git 凭据时启动失败建议重试的问题；现在，错误表明如果存储库错误应该询问谁以及该怎么做

entries.en: Reverted 2.1.329's removal of the automatic retry when `max_tokens` exceeds a model's or gateway's limit
entries.zh: 恢复了 2.1.329 删除了`max_tokens`超过模型或网关限制时的自动重试功能

entries.en: Windows: Improved Grep and Glob speed by no longer starting a console host for each built-in ripgrep search on a local path
entries.zh: Windows：通过不再为本地路径上的每个内置 ripgrep 搜索启动控制台主机，提高了 Grep 和 Glob 的速度

entries.en: Windows: Improved the error when a session's folder is on a drive Claude Code can't verify: it says why, and whether retrying can help
entries.zh: Windows：改进了会话文件夹位于驱动器上时的错误 Claude Code 无法验证：它说明了原因，以及重试是否有帮助

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed `spawn-runner` hooks to start while earlier ones still run, up to `--hook-concurrency` per orchestrator (4 by default); set it to 1 if yours can't run beside another
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：将`spawn-runner`挂钩更改为在早期挂钩仍在运行时启动，每个编排器最多为`--hook-concurrency`（默认为 4）；如果你的无法与另一个一起运行，请将其设置为 1

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed Bash commands to skip the file diff when nothing needs it, so transcripts can lack it; set `bashEditDiffEnabled` to true in managed settings to get every diff
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：更改了 Bash 命令以在不需要时跳过文件差异，因此记录可能会缺少它；在托管设置中将 `bashEditDiffEnabled` 设置为 true 以获取每个差异

entries.en: [VSCode] Added `/fork` to fork a conversation after its last reply (anthropics/claude-code#69272)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 添加了 `/fork` 以在最后回复后分叉对话 (anthropics/claude-code#69272)

entries.en: [VSCode] Added `/workflows`, which opens the agent map with running workflows
entries.zh: [VSCode] 添加了`/workflows`，它打开正在运行的工作流程的代理地图

entries.en: [VSCode] Added the `claudeCode.escapeStopsClaude` setting; turn it off so Escape does not stop Claude (anthropics/claude-code#91536)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 添加了 `claudeCode.escapeStopsClaude` 设置；将其关闭，这样 Escape 就不会阻止克劳德 (anthropics/claude-code#91536)

entries.en: [VSCode] Added the `claudeCode.pinPrompt` setting to let your message scroll away instead of staying pinned
entries.zh: [VSCode] 添加了`claudeCode.pinPrompt`设置，让您的消息滚动离开而不是保持固定状态

entries.en: [VSCode] Added the `claudeCode.contextUsageThreshold` setting for when the context indicator shows (anthropics/claude-code#93036)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 添加了上下文指示器显示时的 `claudeCode.contextUsageThreshold` 设置 (anthropics/claude-code#93036)

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a `prompt` argument to the "Open in Side Bar" command for keybindings and extensions
entries.zh: [VSCode] 为键绑定和扩展的“在侧边栏中打开”命令添加了`prompt`参数

entries.en: [VSCode] Added Move up and Move down to a session group's menu (anthropics/claude-code#98654)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 添加了上移和下移到会话组的菜单 (anthropics/claude-code#98654)

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed VS Code opening and focusing its terminal on every prompt of a connected terminal session
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 VS Code 打开并将其终端聚焦在已连接终端会话的每个提示上的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed copying a code block adding a trailing newline that ran the command on paste (anthropics/claude-code#96976)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了复制代码块时添加在粘贴时运行命令的尾随换行符的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#96976)

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed holding Enter on `/rewind` restoring files, and a double click on Remove or Delete removing a memory, MCP server or plugin marketplace, without confirmation
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在`/rewind`上按住 Enter 恢复文件，然后双击“删除”或“删除”删除内存、MCP 服务器或插件市场而无需确认的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Enter on a question card sending your earlier answer instead of picking the focused one, and arrow keys not working after an "Other" answer; answered questions reopen on your pick
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了问题卡上的 Enter 发送您之前的答案而不是选择焦点答案，以及箭头键在“其他”答案后不起作用的问题；已回答的问题可根据您的选择重新开放

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a held-down Enter key sending a half-written message or running a typed slash command
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了按住 Enter 键发送半写消息或运行键入的斜线命令的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Cmd+A, C, V, X and Z not working in the rename box and dialogs on macOS
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Cmd+A、C、V、X 和 Z 在 macOS 上的重命名框和对话框中不起作用的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+F and Ctrl+P not moving the caret in the message box on macOS
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 macOS 上 Ctrl+F 和 Ctrl+P 无法移动消息框中的插入符号的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the Accept and Reject buttons doing nothing on a proposed diff moved to a new window
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了接受和拒绝按钮在移至新窗口的建议差异上不执行任何操作的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Accept and Reject Proposed Changes showing over the chat, the terminal tab and other files; they now show only on the proposed diff
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在聊天、终端选项卡和其他文件上显示的接受和拒绝建议的更改；它们现在仅显示在建议的差异上

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a slow-starting Claude tab taking the keyboard away from the file you had gone on typing in
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了启动缓慢的 Claude 选项卡，该选项卡使键盘远离您正在输入的文件

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed unsaved changes and new problems being missed on macOS and Linux for files whose path contains `#`, `?` or `%20`, such as a `C#` folder
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了路径包含`#`、`?`或`%20`的文件（例如`C#`文件夹）在 macOS 和 Linux 上丢失未保存的更改和新问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed whole-line selections counting one line too many in the selection chip, in @-mentions and in what Claude is told, and file links leaving out the last line of a range
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在选择芯片、@-提及和 Claude 被告知的内容中整行选择计数过多的一行，以及文件链接遗漏了范围的最后一行的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a conversation forked in the panel re-running an old, unanswered prompt by itself after a window reload
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了面板中分叉的对话，在窗口重新加载后重新运行旧的、未应答的提示

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a forked conversation running the original conversation's `/loop` schedules a second time
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了第二次运行原始对话的`/loop`计划的分叉对话

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed /clear giving no sign that the session still runs without a newly trusted folder's CLAUDE.md and settings
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 /clear 没有迹象表明会话在没有新信任文件夹的 CLAUDE.md 和设置的情况下仍然运行的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed dialogs closing, and losing typed text, when a text selection was dragged past their edge
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当文本选择被拖过其边缘时对话框关闭并丢失键入的文本的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed advisor calls showing as "Unsupported content type" (anthropics/claude-code#73499, anthropics/claude-code#64158, anthropics/claude-code#90471, anthropics/claude-code#73637)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了顾问调用显示为“不受支持的内容类型”的问题（anthropics/claude-code#73499、anthropics/claude-code#64158、anthropics/claude-code#90471、anthropics/claude-code#73637）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list showing no status for the sidebar chat's session (anthropics/claude-code#93898)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了会话列表显示侧边栏聊天会话没有状态的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#93898)

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the plan preview's Add Comment button vanishing after a fast double click on a word
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了快速双击单词后计划预览的“添加评论”按钮消失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed long lines cut off in the Edit Notebook Cell row, permission rules squeezed in a narrow panel, hard-to-see question card marks, and menus moving the chat after a declined trust prompt
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了“编辑笔记本单元格”行中的长行被切断、权限规则挤在狭窄的面板中、难以看到的问卡标记以及在拒绝信任提示后移动聊天的菜单

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed signing in to an account on hold showing a generic failure instead of the on-hold notice and appeal link
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了登录暂停帐户时显示一般失败而不是暂停通知和申诉链接的问题

entries.en: Added a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared
entries.zh: 添加了一个信任对话框警告，说明文件夹的挂钩的声明位置

entries.en: Added a warning in the conversation, in Claude Desktop and other non-interactive hosts, when hooks in managed settings fail to load
entries.zh: 当托管设置中的挂钩无法加载时，在 Claude Desktop 和其他非交互式主机的对话中添加了警告

entries.en: Added this session's scheduled tasks, `/loop` wakeups, the goal and this conversation's forks to `/tasks`; x stops one after asking
entries.zh: 添加了此会话的计划任务、`/loop`唤醒、目标和此对话的分支到`/tasks`； x 问完后停一

entries.en: Added a "Server message" row to a server's page in `/mcp` that shows the JSON-RPC error message of a remote HTTP MCP server that refuses the connection
entries.zh: 在`/mcp`中的服务器页面添加了“服务器消息”行，显示拒绝连接的远程 HTTP MCP 服务器的 JSON-RPC 错误消息

entries.en: Added a "Marketplace auto-update" row to `/status` that names managed marketplaces that get no automatic updates, and why
entries.zh: 在`/status`中添加了“市场自动更新”行，该行命名了没有自动更新的托管市场，以及原因

entries.en: Added support for turning on Code Mode while OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled; each tool call the code makes sends its events; tracing still keeps it off
entries.zh: 添加了在启用 OpenTelemetry 事件和指标时打开代码模式的支持；代码进行的每个工具调用都会发送其事件；追踪仍然让它关闭

entries.en: Improved the automatic clean-up of old sessions on computers with managed settings
entries.zh: 改进了具有托管设置的计算机上旧会话的自动清理

entries.en: Improved `/tui` and other in-place restarts to wait briefly for a login refresh, so they are less likely to sign you out
entries.zh: 改进了`/tui`和其他就地重新启动以短暂等待登录刷新，因此它们不太可能将您注销

entries.en: Improved memory use in long sessions that edit many files, and in long Claude Desktop sessions on macOS and Linux with many large MCP tool results
entries.zh: 改进了编辑多个文件的长时间会话以及 macOS 和 Linux 上具有许多大型 MCP 工具结果的长时间 Claude Desktop 会话中的内存使用情况

entries.en: Improved auto mode's handling of a short reply such as "yes" to Claude's question when telemetry is off, behind a gateway to the Anthropic API, or on Microsoft Foundry
entries.zh: 改进了自动模式对简短回复的处理，例如当遥测关闭、在 Anthropic API 网关后面或在 Microsoft Foundry 上时，对 Claude 的问题回答“是”

entries.en: Improved memory use of idle Claude Desktop and SDK sessions after a long turn, and after `--resume` or `--continue` of a session that holds screenshots or large tool results
entries.zh: 改进了长时间运行后空闲 Claude Desktop 和 SDK 会话的内存使用情况，以及在保存屏幕截图或大型工具结果的会话的`--resume`或`--continue`之后的内存使用情况

entries.en: Improved how fast a Claude Desktop Code session with Remote Control on is ready for the next message after an answer
entries.zh: 改进了远程控制打开的 Claude Desktop Code 会话在应答后准备下一条消息的速度

entries.en: Improved cloud sessions to retry plugins that failed to download at startup
entries.zh: 改进了云会话以重试启动时下载失败的插件

entries.en: Improved Code Mode: the terminal freezes for far less time after a script makes thousands of tool calls
entries.zh: 改进的代码模式：脚本进行数千次工具调用后，终端冻结的时间要少得多

entries.en: Improved Code Mode: after starting a subagent, Claude now gets the same guidance on waiting as outside Code Mode
entries.zh: 改进的代码模式：启动子代理后，克劳德现在获得与外部代码模式相同的等待指导

entries.en: Updated computer use on macOS to newer safety rules, so some actions are refused and some apps have less access
entries.zh: 将 macOS 上的计算机使用更新为新的安全规则，因此某些操作会被拒绝，并且某些应用程序的访问权限会减少

entries.en: Changed saved scheduled tasks: in new signed-in sessions, most saved by earlier versions need scheduling again, though `--resume` of their own session still runs them
entries.zh: 更改了保存的计划任务：在新的登录会话中，大多数早期版本保存的任务需要再次计划，尽管它们自己会话的`--resume`仍然运行它们

entries.en: Changed `/code-review` with no target on most models to review the whole branch against the default branch, and fixed it losing the diff on multi-commit branches
entries.zh: 更改了大多数模型上没有目标的`/code-review`，以根据默认分支检查整个分支，并修复了它在多提交分支上丢失差异的问题

entries.en: Changed auto mode to run `git status` less often so most requests wait less in large repositories; a git command that discards changes may be blocked until the working tree is checked
entries.zh: 更改了自动模式以减少运行`git status`的频率，因此大多数请求在大型存储库中等待的时间更少；放弃更改的 git 命令可能会被阻止，直到检查工作树为止

entries.en: Changed `/code-review <pr number> --fix`, and `/code-review` given a pull request URL, to stop without reviewing when `gh pr diff` is refused or fails
entries.zh: 更改了 `/code-review <pr number> --fix` 和给定拉取请求 URL 的 `/code-review`，以便在 `gh pr diff` 被拒绝或失败时停止而不进行审查

entries.en: Changed 'Exit and stop tasks' to end this session's scheduled tasks so they don't run again on resume, unless you exit while Claude is responding
entries.zh: 更改了“退出并停止任务”以结束此会话的计划任务，以便它们在恢复时不会再次运行，除非您在克劳德响应时退出

entries.en: Changed some teammate panes to start through /bin/sh, so they may not read shell start-up files
entries.zh: 更改了一些队友窗格以通过 /bin/sh 启动，因此他们可能无法读取 shell 启动文件

entries.en: Changed computer use on macOS to give up on an app launch that has not finished after 30 seconds
entries.zh: 更改了 macOS 上的计算机使用方式，以放弃 30 秒后尚未完成的应用程序启动

entries.en: Changed Code Mode so a PreToolUse hook that errors no longer refuses a script's tool call, as outside Code Mode; set `"onFailure": "block"` on a command, HTTP or MCP tool hook that must refuse
entries.zh: 更改了代码模式，因此出现错误的 PreToolUse 挂钩不再像代码模式之外那样拒绝脚本的工具调用；在必须拒绝的命令、HTTP 或 MCP 工具挂钩上设置 `"onFailure": "block"`

entries.en: Changed Code Mode to refuse a script's read of a line range over 256 MiB, which could use gigabytes of memory, and fixed reads of very long lines timing out
entries.zh: 更改了代码模式以拒绝脚本读取超过 256 MiB 的行范围（这可能会使用 GB 的内存），并修复了读取非常长的行超时的问题

entries.en: Changed Code Mode to also start when telemetry, nonessential traffic or feature flags are turned off; an administrator can keep it off in managed settings
entries.zh: 更改了代码模式，以便在遥测、非必要流量或功能标志关闭时也启动；管理员可以在托管设置中将其关闭

entries.en: Changed Code Mode to run a script that declares its own `log`, `preview` or `sleep`, which it used to refuse
entries.zh: 更改了代码模式以运行声明自己的`log`、`preview`或`sleep`的脚本，而它过去会拒绝这些脚本

entries.en: Changed macOS login renewal to test the Keychain with a `Claude Code-write-check` item
entries.zh: 更改了 macOS 登录续订以使用`Claude Code-write-check`项目测试钥匙串

entries.en: Changed the `/tasks` header and the footer's background count to one number covering shells, monitors, MCP calls, agents, workflows and scheduled tasks
entries.zh: 将`/tasks`页眉和页脚的后台计数更改为一个数字，涵盖 shell、监视器、MCP 调用、代理、工作流和计划任务

entries.en: Changed Stop and SubagentStop hooks to list a Monitor's script as `monitor`, not `shell`, in `background_tasks`
entries.zh: 更改了 Stop 和 SubagentStop 挂钩，以在`background_tasks`中将监视器的脚本列为`monitor`，而不是`shell`

entries.en: Fixed `~/.claude.json` sometimes being reset to defaults when a network stall or file lock made it unreadable and cleared during a save
entries.zh: 修复了当网络停顿或文件锁定使其无法读取并在保存期间清除时，`~/.claude.json`有时会重置为默认值的问题

entries.en: Fixed repeated sign-outs on macOS when Claude Code could read the Keychain but not save to it. That session now stops at expiry and says why, and other sessions stay signed in
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude Code 可以读取钥匙串但无法保存到其中时，在 macOS 上重复注销的问题。该会话现在在到期时停止并说明原因，而其他会话保持登录状态

entries.en: Fixed `/terminal-setup` corrupting VS Code settings or keybindings files around block comments, and reporting success while losing the Shift+Enter binding where keybindings.json has an unclosed string
entries.zh: 修复了 `/terminal-setup` 损坏块注释周围的 VS Code 设置或键绑定文件，并报告成功，同时丢失 Shift+Enter 绑定（其中 keybindings.json 具有未闭合字符串）的问题

entries.en: Fixed files accepted through the IDE diff being saved without their last newline, and losing their byte order mark (BOM) when an edit was accepted by saving the diff in VS Code
entries.zh: 修复了通过 IDE diff 接受的文件在保存时没有最后一个换行符的情况下保存的问题，以及通过在 VS Code 中保存 diff 接受编辑时丢失字节顺序标记 (BOM) 的问题

entries.en: Fixed picking a cloud session in `/teleport` replacing your open conversation: the pick now starts a new session, as `/clear` does, and `/resume` brings the old one back
entries.zh: 修复了在`/teleport`中选择一个云会话来替换您打开的对话的问题：该选择现在会启动一个新会话，就像`/clear`所做的那样，而`/resume`则恢复旧会话

entries.en: Fixed `/usage-credits` asking Pro and Max users to log in again after opening the browser, and the link disappearing after 8 seconds if the browser doesn't open and a task stops for usage credits
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage-credits`要求 Pro 和 Max 用户在打开浏览器后再次登录的问题，如果浏览器未打开并且任务停止获取使用积分，则链接会在 8 秒后消失

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` saying usage credits are off when they had run out or reached the monthly limit, and `/model` not telling Pro and Max users when that limit blocks a model that runs on usage credits
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage`表示使用积分在用完或达到每月限制时关闭的问题，以及`/model`不会告诉 Pro 和 Max 用户该限制何时阻止使用使用积分运行的模型

entries.en: Fixed the spend limit menu showing your spend as your monthly limit and wrapping its rows under the pointer in narrow windows
entries.zh: 修复了支出限制菜单，将您的支出显示为每月限额，并将其行包裹在狭窄窗口中的指针下方

entries.en: Fixed a status line script that prints without end freezing the prompt and using gigabytes of memory
entries.zh: 修复了一个状态行脚本，该脚本会打印而不会结束冻结提示并使用千兆字节的内存

entries.en: Fixed an empty, frozen screen after approving managed settings while the --resume picker, the trust dialog or another set-up screen was waiting
entries.zh: 修复了在 --resume 选择器、信任对话框或其他设置屏幕等待时批准托管设置后出现的空白、冻结屏幕

entries.en: Fixed choosing Default in `/model` replacing your saved model with your organization's default when the Default row already showed your saved model
entries.zh: 修复了当“默认”行已显示您保存的模型时，在`/model`中选择“默认”将您保存的模型替换为组织的默认模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed an MCP server being signed in again after you cleared its authentication while a token refresh was running
entries.zh: 修复了在运行令牌刷新时清除其身份验证后再次登录 MCP 服务器的问题

entries.en: Fixed background MCP tasks that stalled after a slow reconnect: Claude Code now reconnects most HTTP MCP servers by itself when one is left on an older protocol version
entries.zh: 修复了重新连接缓慢后停止的后台 MCP 任务：当使用较旧的协议版本时，Claude Code 现在会自行重新连接大多数 HTTP MCP 服务器

entries.en: Fixed PDFs, images and `.docx`, `.xlsx` or `.pptx` files that MCP servers or websites send as `application/octet-stream` being saved as .bin, which kept Claude from reading the PDFs and images
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 服务器或网站作为`application/octet-stream`发送的 PDF、图像以及`.docx`、`.xlsx`或`.pptx`文件被另存为 .bin，这导致 Claude 无法读取 PDF 和图像

entries.en: Fixed `/code-review <pr number>` sometimes reviewing the checked-out branch instead of the pull request without saying so: it now reads the pull request with `gh pr diff`, or says when it can't
entries.zh: 修复了`/code-review <pr number>`有时会审查签出分支而不是拉取请求而无需说明的问题：它现在使用`gh pr diff`读取拉取请求，或者在无法读取时说

entries.en: Fixed `/code-review` stopping at a permission prompt, on most models, to look for a `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` that doesn't exist
entries.zh: 修复了大多数型号上的`/code-review`在权限提示处停止以查找不存在的`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode hiding a script's finished edits and the stopped command after Esc, and losing them on exit
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式隐藏脚本已完成的编辑和 Esc 后停止的命令，并在退出时丢失它们的问题

entries.en: Fixed a runaway loop in Code Mode filling the machine's memory; it is now stopped at a limit
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式下的失控循环填充机器内存的问题；现在已经停在极限了

entries.en: Fixed a background agent running on when it was stopped while it was being resumed
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理在恢复时停止时运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed background shell commands using memory for the earlier conversation until they exit
entries.zh: 修复了后台 shell 命令使用早期对话的内存，直到它们退出

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control using memory for the earlier conversation after a compaction or `/clear` in sessions run by Claude Desktop, IDEs or the SDK
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制在 Claude Desktop、IDE 或 SDK 运行的会话中压缩或`/clear`后使用内存进行早期对话的问题

entries.en: Fixed Stop not ending a request in Claude Desktop sessions on Bedrock while it waits on a hung AWS credential_process or sign-in call
entries.zh: 修复了 Stop 在等待挂起的 AWS credential_process 或登录调用时未结束 Bedrock 上的 Claude Desktop 会话中的请求的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude sometimes failing to send you a file on its first try on Opus 4.8 and Opus 5
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 在 Opus 4.8 和 Opus 5 上首次尝试时有时无法向您发送文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude not being told that a connected MCP server's tools could not be loaded, and taking it for a server with no tools, in sessions with tool search
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德在工具搜索会话中没有被告知无法加载连接的 MCP 服务器的工具，并将其视为没有工具的服务器的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp login` and `/mcp` saying a service doesn't accept sign-ins from Claude Code when the service's client registration had been retired (HTTP 410 Gone)
entries.zh: 修复了`claude mcp login`和`/mcp`，表示当服务的客户端注册已停用时，服务不接受来自 Claude Code 的登录（HTTP 410 消失）

entries.en: Fixed another case of claude.ai-synced plugin hooks failing with "Plugin directory does not exist" while a session was still running on macOS
entries.zh: 修复了当会话仍在 macOS 上运行时 claude.ai 同步插件挂钩失败并显示“插件目录不存在”的另一种情况

entries.en: Fixed auto mode asking for manual approval to `rm` a symlink that points outside the working directory or at itself
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式要求手动批准`rm`指向工作目录之外或自身的符号链接

entries.en: Fixed `/sandbox` on Linux listing `allowUnixSockets` entries as allowed: they don't open those sockets there, and `/sandbox` now says so
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上的`/sandbox`，列出了允许的`allowUnixSockets`条目：它们不会在那里打开那些套接字，`/sandbox`现在是这样说的

entries.en: Fixed pressing Esc twice to clear a mistyped code ending the sign-in in `/install-github-app`
entries.zh: 修复了按 Esc 两次以清除在`/install-github-app`中结束登录的错误输入代码的问题

entries.en: Fixed a removed plugin's MCP server staying connected in headless sessions after `reload_plugins` or when the account's plugin list drops it
entries.zh: 修复了已删除插件的 MCP 服务器在`reload_plugins`之后或当帐户的插件列表删除它时在无头会话中保持连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Claude Docs connector's tools going missing when a plugin or MCP server at the same address failed to connect, and its error wrongly suggesting `/login`
entries.zh: 修复了当同一地址的插件或 MCP 服务器连接失败时，Claude Docs 连接器的工具会丢失，并且错误地提示`/login`

entries.en: Fixed a new skills, commands or agents folder being missed when `--add-dir` names the working directory or Claude Code starts in the home folder
entries.zh: 修复了当`--add-dir`命名工作目录或 Claude Code 在主文件夹中启动时丢失新技能、命令或代理文件夹的问题

entries.en: Fixed sessions started from a pre-warmed process ignoring the `autoCompactWindow` setting in the project's `.claude/settings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了从预热进程启动的会话忽略项目`.claude/settings.json`中的`autoCompactWindow`设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` staying in effect in a running session after it is removed from settings.json
entries.zh: 修复了从 settings.json 中删除后`CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE`在正在运行的会话中仍然有效的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Agent tool's `effort` parameter being ignored for named teammates in agent teams
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队中指定队友忽略代理工具的`effort`参数的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/auto-mode-setup` ignoring recent auto mode denials when it scans a project for rules to suggest; it may now offer allow rules from them, and you review each before it's saved
entries.zh: 修复了`/auto-mode-setup`在扫描项目以获取建议规则时忽略最近的自动模式拒绝的问题；它现在可能会提供来自它们的允许规则，并且您在保存之前查看每个规则

entries.en: Fixed a false "Couldn't save this change" warning after adding a permission rule or directory in a subfolder or worktree whose own `.claude/settings.local.json` is unreadable or malformed
entries.zh: 修复了在自己的`.claude/settings.local.json`不可读或格式错误的子文件夹或工作树中添加权限规则或目录后出现的错误“无法保存此更改”警告

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude to run a network proxy check after a failed request, which auto mode then blocked
entries.zh: 修复了云会话告诉克劳德在请求失败后运行网络代理检查，然后自动模式被阻止的问题

entries.en: Fixed headless rewind and fork going ahead while a message sent right after a model change still waited on it
entries.zh: 修复了模型更改后立即发送的消息仍在等待时无头倒带和分叉继续进行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude not being told when a background task was stopped while a cloud session was restarting
entries.zh: 修复了云会话重新启动时后台任务停止时克劳德没有被告知的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/team-onboarding` reporting a guide as shared on Team and Enterprise plans when the server refused the upload
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器拒绝上传时`/team-onboarding`报告在团队和企业计划中共享的指南

entries.en: Fixed panels and questions being cut off at the prompt in fullscreen, `/help`, history search and the background tasks list losing rows or titles in short windows, and tables wrapping in dialogs
entries.zh: 修复了全屏提示下的面板和问题、`/help`、历史搜索和后台任务列表在短窗口中丢失行或标题以及对话框中的表格的问题

entries.en: Fixed resumed sessions showing "Rejected" or "Declined" for edits, questions and plans that were cut off when the session ended
entries.zh: 修复了在会话结束时被切断的编辑、问题和计划显示“已拒绝”或“已拒绝”的恢复会话

entries.en: Fixed `/passes` showing the wrong number of passes after a server error, and offering usage credits for sharing when no guest passes are left
entries.zh: 修复了`/passes`在服务器错误后显示错误的通行证数量，并在没有留下来宾通行证时提供用于共享的使用积分

entries.en: Fixed `claude --help` output being cut short when piped to another program
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --help`输出在通过管道传输到另一个程序时被缩短的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/terminal-setup` turning on "Use Option as Meta key" in Terminal.app on macOS 27, and tips there suggesting Option+Enter instead of Shift+Enter
entries.zh: 修复了在 macOS 27 上的 Terminal.app 中打开“使用 Option 作为元键”的`/terminal-setup`，并提示建议使用 Option+Enter 而不是 Shift+Enter

entries.en: Fixed sessions on self-hosted environments not starting from a git remote with an SSH host alias, GitHub SSH certificates or a GHE.com SSH user; an unresolved alias's error gives two git commands
entries.zh: 修复了自托管环境中的会话不是从具有 SSH 主机别名、GitHub SSH 证书或 GHE.com SSH 用户的 git 远程启动的问题；未解决的别名错误给出了两个 git 命令

entries.en: Fixed remote MCP servers in self-hosted runner sessions staying without tools, or (over https) disconnected, after a timeout or network error
entries.zh: 修复了自托管运行器会话中的远程 MCP 服务器在超时或网络错误后不使用工具或（通过 https）断开连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions being shown as having stopped responding while Claude Code was still starting
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude Code 仍在启动时，自托管运行器会话显示为已停止响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode keeping in memory every large text file that code read, and memory growing each time a background subagent was woken
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式，将代码读取的每个大文本文件保留在内存中，并且每次唤醒后台子代理时内存都会增长

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode stopping a script at its ten-minute limit while an MCP form, an MCP link prompt or a prompt that always asks was waiting for an answer
entries.zh: 固定代码模式在 MCP 表单、MCP 链接提示或始终询问的提示正在等待答案时停止脚本的十分钟限制

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode scripts receiving a "moved to the background" message as data from most MCP calls over two minutes: the script now waits up to ten minutes, then gets an error
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式脚本在两分钟内接收“已移至后台”消息作为来自大多数 MCP 调用的数据的问题：脚本现在等待长达十分钟，然后收到错误

entries.en: Fixed mods that list only some tools silently turning Code Mode off; such a mod no longer keeps it off, so use managed settings for that
entries.zh: 修复了仅列出一些工具并默默关闭代码模式的 mods；这样的 mod 不再将其关闭，因此请使用托管设置

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode ignoring an MCP tool's request to end the turn when the tool was called from a script that Claude waits for
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude 等待的脚本调用 MCP 工具时，代码模式会忽略该工具结束转弯的请求

entries.en: Fixed a Code Mode script's `let x;` keeping the value that an earlier script gave `x`
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式脚本的`let x;`保留早期脚本给出的值`x`
