entries.en: Fixed a Code Mode script's call with no argument failing with a missing-parameter error on tools that need none
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式脚本的无参数调用失败，并在不需要参数的工具上出现缺少参数错误

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode scripts losing access to tools through `tools` in sessions with more than 4,096 tools
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式脚本在具有超过 4,096 个工具的会话中无法通过“工具”访问工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/code-review` findings card often showing "high" for a review that ran at medium, on most models
entries.zh: 修复了在大多数型号上以中等速度运行的审查中`/code-review`结果卡经常显示“高”的问题

entries.en: Fixed key hints in permission prompts, questions, `/model` and `/rewind` ignoring `keybindings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了权限提示、问题、`/model`和`/rewind`中忽略`keybindings.json`的关键提示

entries.en: Fixed auto-scroll, the PR status badge, the auto-compact warning and the ultracode tag not following the `/config` switches that control them in a running session
entries.zh: 修复了自动滚动、PR 状态徽章、自动压缩警告和超代码标签不遵循在运行会话中控制它们的`/config`开关的问题

entries.en: Fixed a custom cancel key not working in `/add-dir`, `/tui` feedback and the save-workflow form
entries.zh: 修复了自定义取消键在`/add-dir`、`/tui`反馈和保存工作流程表单中不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed arrow keys in the save-workflow form moving the selection in the workflow view behind it
entries.zh: 修复了保存工作流程表单中的箭头键移动其后面的工作流程视图中的选择的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/config` saying nothing, or "dismissed", after changing many settings
entries.zh: 修复了在更改许多设置后`/config`什么也没说或“被解雇”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Read and @-mentions showing one line too many for files that end in a newline
entries.zh: 修复了读取和 @-提及对于以换行符结尾的文件显示过多一行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/status` not naming the model that opusplan and haiku use in plan mode
entries.zh: 修复了`/status`未命名 opusplan 和 haiku 在计划模式下使用的模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude doctor` advising a Keychain unlock inside a macOS sandbox, where unlocking can't help
entries.zh: 修复了`claude doctor`建议在 macOS 沙箱内使用钥匙串解锁的问题，而解锁无济于事

entries.en: Fixed the "Jump to bottom" pill staying hidden after copying text and scrolling away, the row under it going blank when its label changed, and quick PageUp presses scrolling too far in fullscreen
entries.zh: 修复了复制文本并滚动离开后“跳到底部”药丸保持隐藏状态、标签更改时其下方的行变为空白以及快速 PageUp 按键在全屏中滚动距离过远的问题

entries.en: Fixed a screen update sometimes being skipped when memory is low
entries.zh: 修复了内存不足时有时会跳过屏幕更新的问题

entries.en: Fixed long code blocks losing a blank line and repeating another in scrollback
entries.zh: 修复了长代码块丢失空行并在回滚中重复另一个空行的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestions sometimes showing placeholder text such as `_(no suggestion)_`
entries.zh: 修复了提示建议有时显示占位符文本，例如“_（无建议）_”

entries.en: Fixed the line about earlier messages on resume blaming a damaged file when the file was intact
entries.zh: 修复了有关恢复中的早期消息在文件完好无损时指责损坏的文件的行

entries.en: Fixed characters disappearing from the prompt when its text held a color code that sets several styles and a keyword or command was highlighted
entries.zh: 修复了当文本包含设置多种样式的颜色代码并且突出显示关键字或命令时，提示中的字符消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/rename` and `UserPromptSubmit` hook titles in `claude remote-control` sessions not showing on claude.ai and mobile
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Remote-control”会话中的`/rename`和`UserPromptSubmit`挂钩标题未显示在 claude.ai 和移动设备上的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Remote Control diff listing a file twice when the branch renamed it and it was then edited
entries.zh: 修复了当分支重命名文件然后对其进行编辑时，远程控制差异会列出该文件两次

entries.en: Removed 2.1.326's automatic retry at the limit named in a `max_tokens` error; behind a gateway whose model takes fewer output tokens, set `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` to that limit
entries.zh: 删除了 2.1.326 在`max_tokens`错误中指定的限制时的自动重试；在模型需要较少输出令牌的网关后面，将`CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`设置为该限制

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed `--push-outcome-on-release` sometimes deleting a session's branch on the git host
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了`--push-outcome-on-release`有时会删除 git 主机上会话分支的问题

entries.en: Remote Control: Fixed sessions going back to their first effort level after a restart while the app still showed the level you picked (not yet for sessions that start in Ultracode)
entries.zh: 远程控制：固定会话在重新启动后返回到其第一个工作级别，而应用程序仍然显示您选择的级别（对于在 Ultracode 中启动的会话尚不适用）

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed setup failing on Git LFS repositories cloned through Anthropic-managed git; sessions now start on pointer files, and `git lfs pull` fetches the content
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了通过 Anthropic 管理的 git 克隆的 Git LFS 存储库上的安装失败问题；会话现在从指针文件开始，并且`git lfs pull`获取内容

entries.en: Windows: Improved start-up and the first search on PCs where Claude Code's search program starts slowly
entries.zh: Windows：改进了 PC 上的启动和首次搜索，导致 Claude Code 的搜索程序启动缓慢

entries.en: Gateway: Changed the start-up warning shown while `access_control.allow_cidrs` is empty to a notice at every start, boxed in text logs: never expose the gateway to the public internet
entries.zh: 网关：将`access_control.allow_cidrs`为空时显示的启动警告更改为每次启动时显示的通知，并装在文本日志中：切勿将网关暴露于公共互联网

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed a second host name's clone of the same owner/name to go under `_repos/clones/<host>/` in the base folder; no clone moves
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：将相同所有者/名称的第二个主机名的克隆更改为位于基本文件夹中的 `_repos/clones/<host>/` 下；没有克隆动作

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed repositories with unusual characters in their address path to clone anew in a new folder; rules and volumes naming the old one stop applying, and the old clone stays put
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：更改了地址路径中具有异常字符的存储库，以在新文件夹中重新克隆；命名旧规则和卷的规则和卷停止应用，旧克隆保持不变

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed `--repository-folder` to take most folders in the base folder at `--capacity 1` (above 1, one there stops start-up); another repository's session overlapping one is refused
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：更改了`--repository-folder`，以在`--capacity 1`处获取基本文件夹中的大多数文件夹（高于 1，其中一个会停止启动）；另一个存储库的会话与一个重叠的会话被拒绝

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a line above the message box after you decline the trust prompt, with Review trust to bring the prompt back without reloading the window
entries.zh: [VSCode] 在拒绝信任提示后在消息框上方添加了一行，使用“查看信任”可在不重新加载窗口的情况下恢复提示

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed being signed out of Claude Code in every window and terminal when the sign-in server took 10 to 30 seconds to answer the extension's token refresh
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当登录服务器花费 10 到 30 秒来响应扩展的令牌刷新时，在每个窗口和终端中从 Claude Code 中注销的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed keys pressed while an input method (IME) is composing moving focus on or declining a permission prompt, running menu rows and closing dialogs (anthropics/claude-code#106358)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 固定输入法 (IME) 编写时按下的按键，移动焦点或拒绝权限提示、运行菜单行和关闭对话框 (anthropics/claude-code#106358)

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt for Bash, Edit, Write and other built-in tools not showing why a safety check asks
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Bash、Edit、Write 和其他内置工具的权限提示不显示安全检查询问的原因

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a half-written plan comment being lost or moved to another passage, and an input method's Enter sending the comment, ending a session rename or picking an @-mentioned file
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了写了一半的计划注释丢失或移动到另一段，以及输入法的 Enter 发送注释、结束会话重命名或选择@提到的文件

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the limit banner not saying when usage credits are in use, and the session survey covering that banner and the usage credits card
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了限制横幅未说明何时使用使用积分的问题，以及涵盖该横幅和使用积分卡的会话调查

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed screen readers not announcing a permission request that arrived while the Account & Usage dialog was open until that dialog was closed
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了屏幕阅读器在“帐户和使用情况”对话框打开时不会宣布到达的权限请求的问题，直到该对话框关闭为止

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a proposed-edit diff tab staying open, with an Accept button that did nothing, after its terminal Claude Code session disconnected
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在终端 Claude Code 会话断开连接后，建议编辑差异选项卡保持打开状态，且“接受”按钮不执行任何操作的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed short tool inputs and outputs cut off at the panel's edge with no way to read the rest (they now open in an editor tab), and dragging to select text also opening one
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了短工具输入和输出在面板边缘被切断的问题，无法读取其余部分（它们现在在编辑器选项卡中打开），并且拖动以选择文本也会打开一个

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the Up key putting an earlier message over text that an input method (IME) is composing in the message box (anthropics/claude-code#101294)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了向上键将较早的消息放置在输入法 (IME) 在消息框中编写的文本上的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#101294)

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed dropping an Explorer folder onto the chat inserting nothing on VS Code 1.103 to 1.139 or in a floating chat window, and the drop highlight vanishing with a false "Hold Shift" hint
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了将 Explorer 文件夹拖放到聊天中，在 VS Code 1.103 到 1.139 或浮动聊天窗口中不插入任何内容，以及拖放突出显示消失并出现错误的“按住 Shift”提示的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a permission prompt moving keyboard focus away from the details you were scrolling as its buttons switched on
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在按钮打开时将键盘焦点从您滚动的详细信息移开的权限提示

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed file links in a Claude tab opening in another editor group when `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` is off (anthropics/claude-code#108884)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当 `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` 关闭时在另一个编辑器组中打开的 Claude 选项卡中的文件链接 (anthropics/claude-code#108884)

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed ranges written with a single tilde (`3~5 … 7~10`) losing their tildes and showing struck-through text between them; only `~~text~~` is struck through now
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了用单个波浪号（`3~5 … 7~10`）编写的范围丢失波浪号并在它们之间显示删除线的文本；现在只有 `~~text~~` 被删除

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed dictation errors wrapping into a narrow column, the spinner turning while a question card waits, and a NUL symbol after each letter in the output of a failed UTF-16 command
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了听写错误包裹成狭窄的列、问题卡等待时旋转器转动以及失败的 UTF-16 命令输出中每个字母后出现 NUL 符号的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed Down to stop at the last item of a permission prompt instead of wrapping to Yes
entries.zh: [VSCode] 更改为“向下”以停止在权限提示的最后一项，而不是换行为“是”

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed command output to show hidden characters and control sequences other than plain colors as symbols, so Persian, Khmer, Lao, Sinhala and Malayalam text can look broken or out of order
entries.zh: [VSCode] 更改了命令输出，以将除纯色之外的隐藏字符和控制序列显示为符号，因此波斯语、高棉语、老挝语、僧伽罗语和马拉雅拉姆语文本可能看起来损坏或无序

entries.en: Added auto mode for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude apps gateway; interactive sessions with no permission mode start in it
entries.zh: 在 Amazon Bedrock、Google Cloud 代理平台、Microsoft Foundry 和 Claude 应用程序网关上为 Claude Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 添加了自动模式；无权限模式的交互式会话在其中启动

entries.en: Added `"onFailure": "block"` for `mcp_tool` hooks, as for command and HTTP hooks: a hook whose call fails blocks the action
entries.zh: 为 `mcp_tool` 钩子添加了 `"onFailure": "block"`，对于命令和 HTTP 钩子：调用失败的钩子会阻止操作

entries.en: Added a warning when a message from a session that skips permission prompts may be held and dropped by a cloud session
entries.zh: 添加了当来自跳过权限提示的会话的消息可能被云会话保留和删除时的警告

entries.en: Added a notice in `/status` and `claude doctor` when an OpenTelemetry exporter has no endpoint and its data would likely be lost
entries.zh: 当 OpenTelemetry 导出器没有端点并且其数据可能会丢失时，在`/status`和`claude doctor`中添加了通知

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DEFERRED_TOOL_RESUME`, which lets a host stop `claude -p --resume` and `--continue` from running a tool call that a hook deferred
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DEFERRED_TOOL_RESUME`，它允许主机停止`claude -p --resume`和`--continue`运行钩子延迟的工具调用

entries.en: Added support for apps that embed Claude Code to switch on the policy plugin's `allowManagedModsOnly` option; an admin's managed settings still win
entries.zh: 添加了对嵌入 Claude Code 的应用程序的支持，以打开策略插件的`allowManagedModsOnly`选项；管理员的托管设置仍然获胜

entries.en: Added a startup warning to the Claude apps gateway when a policy's `maxEffortLevel` is not a valid effort level
entries.zh: 当策略的`maxEffortLevel`不是有效的工作级别时，向 Claude 应用程序网关添加了启动警告

entries.en: Improved `claude -p` and SDK sessions to fetch managed-settings plugins that have their own git repository, in the background, for a later session
entries.zh: 改进了`claude -p`和 SDK 会话，以在后台获取拥有自己的 git 存储库的托管设置插件，以供以后的会话使用

entries.en: Improved how soon managed-settings plugins from a git marketplace load on a fresh machine in `claude -p`, SDK and Claude Desktop sessions; a short run may exit up to 30 seconds later
entries.zh: 改进了在`claude -p`、SDK 和 Claude 桌面会话中将 git 市场中的托管设置插件加载到新计算机上的速度；短期运行最多可能会在 30 秒后退出

entries.en: Improved the time to resume large sessions
entries.zh: 缩短了恢复大型会话的时间

entries.en: Improved memory use when resuming a session with many images
entries.zh: 恢复包含许多图像的会话时改进了内存使用

entries.en: Improved memory use and response time in long SDK and desktop sessions that run slow commands or tools
entries.zh: 改进了运行缓慢命令或工具的长 SDK 和桌面会话中的内存使用和响应时间

entries.en: Improved Code Mode's speed in auto and bypass-permissions modes by removing a 0.75 second pause after most scripts
entries.zh: 通过消除大多数脚本后的 0.75 秒暂停，提高了自动和旁路权限模式下代码模式的速度

entries.en: Improved prompt caching for new Code Mode sessions that have MCP servers, and Claude is now told when a server is still connecting and when the list of servers changes
entries.zh: 改进了具有 MCP 服务器的新代码模式会话的提示缓存，现在可以告诉 Claude 服务器何时仍在连接以及服务器列表何时更改

entries.en: Improved Code Mode's token use with shorter tool descriptions
entries.zh: 通过更短的工具描述改进了代码模式的令牌使用

entries.en: Improved Code Mode to show the command a script is running, and its output, while it runs
entries.zh: 改进的代码模式可在运行时显示脚本正在运行的命令及其输出

entries.en: Improved Code Mode edits: an edit that changes nothing no longer stops a script, and Claude is told where a failed edit matches or comes closest
entries.zh: 改进的代码模式编辑：不进行任何更改的编辑不再停止脚本，并且克劳德被告知失败的编辑匹配或最接近的位置

entries.en: Improved Code Mode: Claude is now told which tool calls were still running when a script failed
entries.zh: 改进的代码模式：现在，当脚本失败时，克劳德会被告知哪些工具调用仍在运行

entries.en: Improved how Claude starts dev servers in Code Mode's auto and bypass modes: Claude is told to run them as background tasks that show in `/tasks`
entries.zh: 改进了 Claude 在代码模式的自动和旁路模式下启动开发服务器的方式：Claude 被告知将它们作为后台任务运行，显示在`/tasks`中

entries.en: Improved starting several in-process teammates at once: far fewer now fail with "Lock file is already being held"
entries.zh: 改进了同时启动多个正在进行的队友的功能：现在因“锁定文件已被保留”而失败的情况要少得多

entries.en: Improved the computer use approval dialog: it now shows each app's level of access and plainer warnings
entries.zh: 改进了计算机使用批准对话框：它现在显示每个应用程序的访问级别和更简单的警告

entries.en: Improved cross-session messaging: Claude now explains that Remote Control is off when a cloud session or another computer is not listed
entries.zh: 改进的跨会话消息传递：克劳德现在解释说，当未列出云会话或另一台计算机时，远程控制将关闭

entries.en: Improved `claude -p` text output to say on stderr when a message from another session is held or dropped, and how to allow it
entries.zh: 改进了`claude -p`文本输出，以在来自另一个会话的消息被保留或删除时在 stderr 上显示，以及如何允许它

entries.en: Improved Claude's answers on who can open an artifact it published: Claude is now told to check the artifact again instead of repeating the last publish's answer
entries.zh: 改进了克劳德关于谁可以打开其发布的工件的答案：现在告诉克劳德再次检查工件，而不是重复上次发布的答案

entries.en: Improved resumed self-hosted runner sessions: Claude now checks whether its earlier work is still there, and says what is missing
entries.zh: 改进了恢复的自托管运行器会话：克劳德现在检查其早期的工作是否仍然存在，并指出缺少的内容

entries.en: Changed plan mode and Bash prompts for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on third-party providers to use and offer auto mode, as on newer models; `disableAutoMode` turns both off
entries.zh: 更改了第三方提供商上 Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 的计划模式和 Bash 提示，以使用和提供自动模式，与较新的型号一样； `disableAutoMode` 关闭两者

entries.en: Changed Code Mode to no longer run UserPromptSubmit hooks, managed ones included, on scripts' output; to redact that output, use a PostToolUse hook with `updatedToolOutput`
entries.zh: 更改了代码模式，不再在脚本输出上运行 UserPromptSubmit 挂钩（包括托管挂钩）；要编辑该输出，请使用带有`updatedToolOutput`的 PostToolUse 挂钩

entries.en: Changed `/code-review` on most models to report only bugs and CLAUDE.md violations; run `/simplify` for reuse, simplification and efficiency cleanups
entries.zh: 更改了大多数模型上的`/code-review`，仅报告错误和 CLAUDE.md 违规；运行`/simplify`以进行重用、简化和效率清理

entries.en: Changed `/code-review` to mark each finding Important, Pre-existing or Nit on most models, and to end each summary with a suggested fix; a clean review's list now reads "Code review found no issues."
entries.zh: 更改了`/code-review`，以在大多数型号上将每个发现标记为“重要”、“预先存在”或“Nit”，并以建议的修复结束每个摘要；干净的审查列表现在显示为“代码审查未发现问题”。

entries.en: Changed `deniedMcpServers` entries of the form `claude.ai <name>` to apply to that connector in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions too
entries.zh: 更改了`claude.ai <name>`形式的`deniedMcpServers`条目，以应用于云中的连接器和自托管运行器会话

entries.en: Changed managed `PostToolUse` hooks to no longer fire for calls refused before they ran: no log entry, rewrite, block or stop there; `PostToolBatch` gets most, not marked as refused
entries.zh: 更改了托管的`PostToolUse`挂钩，使其不再因运行前拒绝的调用而触发：没有日志条目、重写、阻止或停止； `PostToolBatch` 获得最多，未标记为拒绝

entries.en: Changed `/bug` to ask Yes or No before sending, so repeated Enters no longer send a report or open GitHub
entries.zh: 将 `/bug` 改为在发送前询问 Yes 或 No，因此重复 Enter 不再发送报告或打开 GitHub

entries.en: Changed subagents in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, desktop and VS Code to wait for their own subagents by default when `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` is set
entries.zh: 更改了`claude -p`、Agent SDK、桌面和 VS Code 中的子代理，以在设置`CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0`时默认等待自己的子代理

entries.en: Changed `claude -p` with `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` to count a background subagent and those it waits for against one 10-minute wait; raise `CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS` for longer chains
entries.zh: 将`claude -p`更改为`CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0`，以计算后台子代理及其等待的 10 分钟等待时间；提高`CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS`以获得更长的链

entries.en: Changed a shell command rewritten by a PermissionRequest hook to a sandbox-excluded command to run outside the sandbox
entries.zh: 将 PermissionRequest 挂钩重写的 shell 命令更改为沙箱排除命令，以便在沙箱外运行

entries.en: Changed the Claude in Chrome welcome screen and `/chrome` to say that Claude Code asks before Claude acts on a site, unless your permission mode or a rule in `/permissions` answers
entries.zh: 更改了 Chrome 欢迎屏幕和`/chrome`中的 Claude，表示 Claude 代码在 Claude 对网站进行操作之前会询问，除非您的权限模式或`/permissions`中的规则回答

entries.en: Changed Claude Desktop and Agent SDK sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags off to end the turn when closed with a question open, instead of continuing without an answer
entries.zh: 更改了第三方提供商的 Claude Desktop 和 Agent SDK 会话，或者使用遥测或功能标记关闭，以在有问题关闭时结束回合，而不是在没有答案的情况下继续

entries.en: Changed pasted text to be marked for Claude as pasted, on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off
entries.zh: 更改了粘贴的文本，以在第三方提供商上或关闭遥测或功能标志的情况下将克劳德标记为粘贴

entries.en: Changed subagent progress summaries in terminal sessions on the Anthropic API to be written by the default small fast model from short notes, also with telemetry off, using far fewer tokens
entries.zh: 将 Anthropic API 上的终端会话中的子代理进度摘要更改为由默认的小型快速模型从简短的注释编写，也关闭了遥测，使用更少的令牌

entries.en: Changed how a sandbox that can't start is reported, unless `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` is set: the next sandboxed Bash command is refused and says that the sandbox is off for the session
entries.zh: 更改了报告无法启动的沙箱的方式，除非设置了`sandbox.failIfUnavailable`：下一个沙箱 Bash 命令被拒绝，并表示会话的沙箱已关闭

entries.en: Changed `/list-agents` to show its list to you alone; Claude lists sessions itself when needed
entries.zh: 更改了`/list-agents`以仅向您显示其列表；克劳德在需要时自行列出会话

entries.en: Changed self-hosted runners at `--capacity 1` to refuse a session earlier when the path of a repository it pushes to is a symbolic link
entries.zh: 更改了`--capacity 1`处的自托管运行程序，以便在推送到的存储库的路径是符号链接时更早地拒绝会话

entries.en: Fixed Bash commands in zsh stopping with a "not found" error at a word that starts with `=`, such as `echo ====` or `[ a == b ]`; `=cmd` no longer expands to a command's path
entries.zh: 修复了 zsh 中的 Bash 命令在以 `=` 开头的单词处停止并出现“未找到”错误的问题，例如 `echo ====` 或 `[ a == b ]`； `=cmd` 不再扩展为命令的路径

entries.en: Fixed automatic compaction reusing the session's earlier system prompt instead of rebuilding it the way `/compact` does
entries.zh: 修复了自动压缩，重用会话的早期系统提示符，而不是像`/compact`那样重建它

entries.en: Fixed markdown rendering freezing on some very long or malformed input
entries.zh: 修复了某些很长或格式错误的输入上的 Markdown 渲染冻结问题

entries.en: Fixed rare screen freezes
entries.zh: 修复了罕见的屏幕冻结问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc often being lost at a permission prompt or question when you typed straight after it; in terminals that send Alt as Esc and a key, an unused Alt or Option key now declines there
entries.zh: 修复了当您直接输入 Esc 时，在出现权限提示或问题时经常会丢失 Esc 的问题；在将 Alt 作为 Esc 和键发送的终端中，未使用的 Alt 或 Option 键现在会被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed a paste or a terminal's reply being typed into the prompt when a slow connection cut it in two
entries.zh: 修复了当连接速度较慢将其分成两部分时在提示中输入粘贴或终端回复的问题

entries.en: Fixed saving a scheduled task erasing the project's other saved tasks when the scheduled tasks file can't be read, on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off
entries.zh: 修复了在第三方提供商上或在遥测或功能标志关闭的情况下无法读取计划任务文件时保存计划任务会删除项目的其他已保存任务的问题

entries.en: Fixed a scheduled task with a typo in the project's scheduled tasks file being deleted the next time that file was saved
entries.zh: 修复了项目计划任务文件中存在拼写错误的计划任务，该文件在下次保存该文件时被删除

entries.en: Fixed a case where a resumed cloud session could lose its compaction summary or recent messages when a message was saved late
entries.zh: 修复了当消息保存较晚时恢复的云会话可能会丢失其压缩摘要或最近消息的情况

entries.en: Fixed the token counts on the spinner and for subagents counting a retried reply twice, missing replies that were not streamed, and standing still while Claude thinks
entries.zh: 修复了旋转器上的令牌计数以及子代理对重试回复进行两次计数、丢失未流式传输的回复以及在克劳德思考时保持静止的问题

entries.en: Fixed the error shown when usage credits run out mid-response, which named a rate limit
entries.zh: 修复了使用积分在响应中耗尽时显示的错误，该错误称为速率限制

entries.en: Fixed auto mode failing every turn outside Claude Desktop with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set behind a gateway rejecting betas, on Bedrock, Agent Platform, Foundry or Claude apps gateway
entries.zh: 修复了在基岩、代理平台、Foundry 或 Claude 应用程序网关上，在网关后面设置了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS`并拒绝 Beta 版的情况下，在 Claude Desktop 之外的自动模式每次都会失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` not lengthening the 5-minute connection limit on gateways, custom base URLs and cloud providers
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS`不延长网关、自定义基本 URL 和云提供商的 5 分钟连接限制的问题

entries.en: Fixed some Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers, other than scheduled tasks, ending for good with "Prompt is too long" after large tool results; the largest are now left out
entries.zh: 修复了除计划任务之外的第三方提供商的一些克劳德桌面会话，在大型工具结果后以“提示太长”结束；最大的现在被排除在外

entries.en: Fixed MCP tools whose input schema starts with `anyOf`, `oneOf` or `allOf` going missing on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off
entries.zh: 修复了输入模式以`anyOf`、`oneOf`或`allOf`开头的 MCP 工具在第三方提供商中丢失或遥测或功能标志关闭的问题

entries.en: Fixed an MCP tool with an invalid input schema failing requests on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off; the tool is now left out and Claude is told why
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 工具的输入模式无效，导致第三方提供商请求失败或遥测或功能标志关闭；该工具现在被排除在外，并告诉克劳德原因

entries.en: Fixed effort being turned off for a subagent's model for the session if Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform or Foundry refused its progress summary's effort setting (regression in 2.1.327)
entries.zh: 修复了如果 Bedrock、Google Cloud 的代理平台或 Foundry 拒绝其进度摘要的工作量设置，会话子代理模型的工作量将被关闭的问题（2.1.327 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode stopping a script when a permission prompt outside auto or bypass mode, a plan approval or a question stayed open for ten minutes
entries.zh: 固定代码模式在自动或旁路模式之外的权限提示、计划批准或问题保持开放十分钟时停止脚本

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode scripts in auto and bypass-permissions modes failing to call an MCP server that had connected while the previous script was running
entries.zh: 修复了自动和旁路权限模式下的代码模式脚本无法调用在上一个脚本运行时已连接的 MCP 服务器的问题

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode scripts not running in the background in auto or bypass permissions mode in a session chosen in the `claude --resume` picker
entries.zh: 修复了在`claude --resume`选择器中选择的会话中，代码模式脚本不在后台以自动或绕过权限模式运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode losing a loaded skill, hook context or a note typed with a permission approval when resuming a session in which one reply ran several scripts
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式在恢复一个回复运行多个脚本的会话时丢失加载的技能、挂钩上下文或经权限批准键入的注释的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude not being told that a Code Mode script was cut off when the session was resumed from the picker or in a mode that asks for permission
entries.zh: 修复了当从选择器恢复会话或处于请求许可的模式时，克劳德没有被告知代码模式脚本被切断的问题

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode silently using `undefined` for top-level variables that an earlier failed script never set
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式，静默使用“未定义”作为早期失败脚本从未设置的顶级变量

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode scripts not being told when a failing command's long output was cut
entries.zh: 修复了当失败命令的长输出被切断时不会告知代码模式脚本的问题

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode refusing valid scripts that start with a `{` block
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式拒绝以`{`块开头的有效脚本

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode refusing scripts that use both a top-level `await` and a top-level `return`
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式拒绝同时使用顶级`await`和顶级`return`的脚本

entries.en: Fixed an @-mentioned small file not being attached in Code Mode after a script had read or written it
entries.zh: 修复了脚本读取或写入后，@提到的小文件未在代码模式中附加的问题

entries.en: Fixed Code Mode offering `write()` and `edit()` to read-only subagents that can't call them
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式，为无法调用它们的只读子代理提供`write()`和`edit()`

entries.en: Fixed Claude starting a turn by itself in Code Mode when Esc was followed by a command such as `/model`
entries.zh: 修复了当 Esc 后跟`/model`等命令时克劳德在代码模式下自行开始转弯的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Code Mode not being told to run workflows only when you ask, or the workflow size you set in `/config`
entries.zh: 修复了代码模式下的克劳德仅在您询问时才被告知运行工作流程，或者您在`/config`中设置的工作流程大小的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control repeating the same disconnect message, and telling you to retry a session that can't reconnect
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制重复相同的断开连接消息，并告诉您重试无法重新连接的会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed a waiting permission prompt being lost, and its answer ignored, when a remote session restarted while the service was slow
entries.zh: 修复了当远程会话在服务缓慢时重新启动时，等待权限提示丢失且其答案被忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions resuming a cleared conversation after a rewind followed by `/clear`
entries.zh: 修复了云会话在倒回后按`/clear`恢复已清除的对话的问题

entries.en: Fixed a remote session losing a turn's tool calls and results when its runner or worker was lost after a dropped model stream had been retried
entries.zh: 修复了在重试删除的模型流后，当运行程序或工作人员丢失时，远程会话会丢失回合的工具调用和结果

entries.en: Fixed cloud and Remote Control sessions that just started, or have an @ in their title, being unreachable in cross-session messaging from a session with Remote Control on
entries.zh: 修复了刚刚启动的云和远程控制会话，或者标题中带有 @ 的会话，在远程控制打开的会话中无法通过跨会话消息传递进行访问

entries.en: Fixed Claude being told that cloud sessions can never reply; it now learns when a reply can come and how else to get the result
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德被告知云会话永远无法回复的问题；现在它知道何时可以收到回复以及如何获得结果

entries.en: Fixed `/diff`, the Changes pane of Remote Control sessions and the diff beside an edit leaving out committed work after a command moved into another repository
entries.zh: 修复了`/diff`、远程控制会话的“更改”窗格以及命令移动到另一个存储库后遗漏已提交工作的编辑旁边的差异

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control not showing a running workflow's agents when a session run by an IDE extension or other SDK app is opened over an hour after the workflow last made progress
entries.zh: 修复了当工作流上次取得进展后一个小时内打开由 IDE 扩展或其他 SDK 应用程序运行的会话时，远程控制不显示正在运行的工作流的代理

entries.en: Fixed the model saying background agents were still running after an SDK interrupt had stopped them
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 中断停止后后台代理仍在运行的模型

entries.en: Fixed Send now in the desktop app and SDK hosts telling Claude that a stopped web search found no results
entries.zh: 修复了桌面应用程序和 SDK 主机中的“立即发送”告诉 Claude 已停止的网络搜索未找到任何结果

entries.en: Fixed Cmd+letter being typed into the prompt in terminals that report Cmd
entries.zh: 修复了在报告 Cmd 的终端中在提示中键入 Cmd+字母的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+click opening a link twice in GNOME Terminal, side mouse buttons acting as clicks, and the first wheel notch in the other direction being ignored after a pause, in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下，Ctrl+单击在 GNOME 终端中打开链接两次、鼠标侧键充当单击以及暂停后另一个方向的第一个滚轮凹口被忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed Shift+Enter in Konsole outside tmux and ssh, and Alt shortcuts on non-Latin keyboard layouts in terminals that speak the kitty keyboard protocol
entries.zh: 修复了 tmux 和 ssh 之外的 Konsole 中的 Shift+Enter，以及使用 kitty 键盘协议的终端中非拉丁键盘布局上的 Alt 快捷键

entries.en: Fixed text copied in fullscreen mode including the quote bar, losing spaces at line wraps when a drag scrolled upward, or missing words under the "Jump to bottom" pill
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下复制的文本，包括引号栏、向上滚动时在换行处丢失空格，或“跳到底部”药丸下缺少单词

entries.en: Fixed an image path pasted into a `!` command becoming an attachment
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴到`!`命令中的图像路径成为附件的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C showing no exit warning while the `?` shortcuts list is open
entries.zh: 修复了`?`快捷方式列表打开时 Ctrl+C 不显示退出警告的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+R search in fullscreen mode and the `/theme` color editor picking the wrong row when keys arrive together, and keys being dropped there and in the search of `/config` and `/plugin`
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下的 Ctrl+R 搜索和`/theme`颜色编辑器在按键一起到达时选择错误的行，以及在`/config`和`/plugin`搜索中将按键拖放到那里的问题

entries.en: Fixed wrong or missing colors inside GNU screen
entries.zh: 修复了 GNU 屏幕内错误或缺失的颜色

entries.en: Fixed many background notifications cutting into the top border of open dialogs in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下许多后台通知切入打开对话框的顶部边框的问题

entries.en: Fixed a message to a background agent showing a long file path in place of a pasted image
entries.zh: 修复了向后台代理显示一条长文件路径而不是粘贴图像的消息

entries.en: Fixed `/goal` removing a skill's Stop hook, or ending early on another hook's result, when both had the same wording
entries.zh: 修复了`/goal`删除技能的“停止”钩子，或者当两者具有相同措辞时提前结束另一个钩子的结果

entries.en: Fixed `/bug` saying cancelled after the report was sent
entries.zh: 修复了`/bug`在发送报告后说已取消的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc not dismissing the transcript share question for Pro and Max users
entries.zh: 修复了 Esc 不会忽略 Pro 和 Max 用户的成绩单共享问题

entries.en: Fixed `/hooks` losing your place when going back
entries.zh: 修复了`/hooks`返回时丢失位置的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/export` writing a file named `.txt` when the name was left empty
entries.zh: 修复了当名称留空时`/export`写入名为`.txt`的文件

entries.en: Fixed `/terminal-setup` in Zed replacing a symlinked `keymap.json` with a plain file
entries.zh: 修复了 Zed 中的`/terminal-setup`，用普通文件替换符号链接的`keymap.json`

entries.en: Fixed `/install-github-app` adding a code review workflow when asked to update the existing workflow file
entries.zh: 修复了`/install-github-app`在要求更新现有工作流程文件时添加代码审查工作流程的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` reopening a skill, or closing the open page, when a slow save or removal finished after you went back
entries.zh: 修复了返回后缓慢保存或删除完成时`/plugin`重新打开技能或关闭打开的页面的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` asking to uninstall the wrong plugin, or ignoring Esc, after leaving a plugin while a change was still running
entries.zh: 修复了在更改仍在运行时离开插件后要求卸载错误插件或忽略 Esc 的`/plugin`问题

entries.en: Fixed typing and arrow keys not working on the `/plugin` Installed tab after a search with no results or a click on the tab row
entries.zh: 修复了搜索无结果或单击选项卡行后，键入和箭头键在`/plugin`已安装选项卡上不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed holding Enter in `/plugin` turning off several installed plugins
entries.zh: 修复了在`/plugin`中按住 Enter 关闭多个已安装插件的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/usage` plugin total stopping at 2,000 tokens on 1M context models, and low token estimates in `/usage` and `/plugin` when no model is picked
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage`插件在 1M 上下文模型上总共停止于 2,000 个令牌，以及在未选择模型时`/usage`和`/plugin`中的令牌估计值较低的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc on the Bedrock access keys step closing `/login` instead of going back
entries.zh: 修复了基岩访问键上的 Esc 步骤关闭`/login`而不是返回

entries.en: Fixed `/exit` and Ctrl+D describing running work differently, and `/exit` warning about a workflow that had stopped
entries.zh: 修复了以不同方式描述运行工作的`/exit`和 Ctrl+D，以及有关已停止工作流程的`/exit`警告

entries.en: Fixed Claude calling an artifact private after reading one in a shared folder or publishing to another organization's, and saying only named people can open one when its folder's people can too
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德在阅读共享文件夹中的工件或发布到另一个组织的工件后将工件称为私有的问题，并表示只有指定的人才能打开该工件，而该文件夹的人员也可以打开该工件

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's toast sometimes showing another plugin's text
entries.zh: 修复了插件的 toast 有时显示另一个插件的文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod saved just after a turn began sometimes reloading mid-turn instead of at the turn's end
entries.zh: 修复了回合开始后保存的模组有时会在回合中而不是回合结束时重新加载的问题

entries.en: Fixed one malformed `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` entry dropping the variable's other labels from metric points, events, and spans. Now only that entry is left off
entries.zh: 修复了一个格式错误的`OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES`条目，该条目会从指标点、事件和跨度中删除变量的其他标签。现在只剩下该条目了

entries.en: Fixed agent hooks running past their timeout while compacting after a request was refused as too large
entries.zh: 修复了请求因太大而被拒绝后压缩时代理挂钩运行超时的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash at startup when `FORCE_COLOR` is set to a negative number
entries.zh: 修复了`FORCE_COLOR`设置为负数时启动时的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed a crash in secret masking when the machine is almost out of memory
entries.zh: 修复了机器内存几乎耗尽时秘密屏蔽的崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed the Bash sandbox on Linux renaming `.git/HEAD` after each command when the branch name is not valid UTF-8
entries.zh: 修复了当分支名称不是有效的 UTF-8 时，Linux 上的 Bash 沙箱在每个命令后重命名 `.git/HEAD`

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runners stopping when their token ran out on a host whose clock is slow or was set back
entries.zh: 修复了当时钟速度慢或被延迟的主机上的令牌耗尽时，自托管运行程序会停止的问题

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runners with Anthropic-managed git being unable to fetch or push where the machine's git config sets `http.proactiveAuth`
entries.zh: 修复了由 Anthropic 管理的 git 无法在机器的 git 配置设置`http.proactiveAuth`的位置获取或推送的自托管运行器

entries.en: Fixed the self-hosted runner skipping its post-session hook when a disk stalled for a few seconds; on a dead disk a session's end can take 25 seconds longer by default
entries.zh: 修复了当磁盘停止几秒钟时自托管运行器跳过其会话后挂钩的问题；在死磁盘上，默认情况下会话结束可能需要多花 25 秒

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runners: a session that resumes in a new Claude config directory no longer loses its task list
entries.zh: 修复了自托管运行程序：在新的 Claude 配置目录中恢复的会话不再丢失其任务列表

entries.en: Fixed Claude not being told when a self-hosted session starts without one of its repositories, and why
entries.zh: 修复了当自托管会话在没有其存储库的情况下启动时克劳德没有被告知的问题，以及原因

entries.en: Fixed the self-hosted runner setup wizard's key rotation advice, which now warns that revoking a key stops the sessions running under it
entries.zh: 修复了自托管运行器设置向导的密钥轮换建议，该建议现在警告撤销密钥会停止在其下运行的会话

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Added `--repository-folder` to name the folder that sessions use for a repository at `--capacity 1`, in place of its path under the base folder, which can't be a symbolic link
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：添加了`--repository-folder`来命名会话用于存储库的文件夹`--capacity 1`，代替其在基本文件夹下的路径，该文件夹不能是符号链接

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Added a start-up warning when the host's settings.json sets a default permission mode that sessions ignore
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：当主机的settings.json设置会话忽略的默认权限模式时添加启动警告

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Added `--hook-label` to `claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator`, to hand chosen session labels to the `spawn-runner` hook
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：向“claude self-hosted-runner Orchestrator”添加了`--hook-label`，以将选定的会话标签传递给`spawn-runner`挂钩

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Added `--metadata key=value` to `claude --environment`, to label a session for the `spawn-runner` hook
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：将`--metadata key=value`添加到`claude --environment`，以标记`spawn-runner`挂钩的会话

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Added `claude_code_self_hosted_orchestrator_session_queue_wait_by_reason_seconds` to the orchestrator's `/metrics`, so a re-opened session's wait can be told from a new one's
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：将`claude_code_self_hosted_orchestrator_session_queue_wait_by_reason_seconds`添加到协调器的`/metrics`中，因此可以从新会话的等待中得知重新打开的会话的等待时间

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Added an orchestrator metric, `claude_code_self_hosted_orchestrator_sessions_given_up_total`, that counts by cause how often Anthropic gave up starting a runner for a session
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：添加了一个协调器指标`claude_code_self_hosted_orchestrator_sessions_given_up_total`，该指标根据 Anthropic 放弃启动会话运行器的频率进行计数

entries.en: Remote Control: Fixed an idle Desktop or VS Code session showing as running after Remote Control is turned on
entries.zh: 远程控制：修复了打开远程控制后显示为正在运行的空闲桌面或 VS Code 会话

entries.en: Linux: Fixed pasting in other apps freezing while Claude Code is suspended with Ctrl+Z, when `xclip` or `wl-copy` is installed
entries.zh: Linux：修复了安装`xclip`或`wl-copy`时，使用 Ctrl+Z 暂停 Claude Code 时其他应用程序中的粘贴冻结问题

entries.en: Linux: Fixed Ctrl+V missing the clipboard image, pasting an old one or hanging
entries.zh: Linux：修复了 Ctrl+V 丢失剪贴板图像、粘贴旧图像或挂起的问题

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed all running sessions being stopped when a proxy or web filter answered a poll with HTTP 200 and a body such as `{}`; the runner now retries such a poll
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了当代理或 Web 过滤器使用 HTTP 200 和`{}`等正文回答轮询时所有正在运行的会话停止的问题；跑步者现在重试这样的民意调查

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed deletion of a kept clone's objects or refs, and of commits that existed only there, after a temporary disk error; that start now fails instead
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了在临时磁盘错误后删除保留克隆的对象或引用以及仅存在于其中的提交的问题；现在开始失败了

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with Anthropic-managed git losing git access to GitHub after a script or hook in the session ran `claude` again
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了与 Anthropic 管理的 git 的会话在会话中的脚本或挂钩再次运行`claude`后丢失 git 访问 GitHub 的问题

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a runner that exited without telling the server when setup failed after it had registered; it now deregisters with a reason, and an on-demand runner reports the failed start
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了注册后安装失败时退出而不通知服务器的运行器；现在它会因某种原因取消注册，并且按需运行程序会报告启动失败

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session not taking effect while it waited for another session to prepare the same repository (`--capacity` above 1)
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了在等待另一个会话准备同一存储库时存档或重新排队会话不生效的问题（`--capacity` 高于 1）

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a session with a damaged `.claude.json` failing every later start under `--trust-workspace false`; it now starts on defaults, with MCP servers turned off there on again
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了`.claude.json`损坏的会话在`--trust-workspace false`下每次启动失败的问题；现在默认启动，MCP 服务器关闭并再次打开

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a failed start's message losing the words that say what failed when a checkout hook or git printed a lot
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了失败的启动消息，当结帐钩子或 git 打印大量内容时，该消息会丢失说明失败的内容

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed `--correlation-id` of `claude --environment` not reaching the `spawn-runner` hook
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了`claude --environment`的`--correlation-id`未到达`spawn-runner`挂钩

entries.en: Windows: Improved Code Mode by telling Claude that scripts' shell commands run in Git Bash and that PowerShell aliases run instead of functions with the same name
entries.zh: Windows：改进了代码模式，告诉 Claude 脚本的 shell 命令在 Git Bash 中运行，并且运行 PowerShell 别名而不是同名的函数

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed the built-in `gh api` to be off by default where settings guard Claude's GitHub tools by name; `--use-anthropic-gh true` turns it on
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：将内置`gh api`更改为默认关闭，其中设置按名称保护 Claude 的 GitHub 工具； `--use-anthropic-gh true` 打开它

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed a `claude` that a wrapper script runs before the session's own `claude` is up, or after it has ended, to have no Anthropic-managed git
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：更改了包装器脚本在会话自己的`claude`启动之前或结束后运行的`claude`，以没有 Anthropic 管理的 git

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed `CLAUDE_RUNNER_SESSION_UUID` and `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_UUID` to both be set for the session and its `checkout`, `post-session` and `spawn-runner` hooks
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：将`CLAUDE_RUNNER_SESSION_UUID`和`CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_UUID`更改为会话及其`checkout`、`post-session`和`spawn-runner`挂钩

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a notice when a message from another session is held, with a link to the settings file that can allow it
entries.zh: [VSCode] 添加了当来自另一个会话的消息被保留时的通知，以及可以允许它的设置文件的链接

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt cutting off its No button, reply field or title when the panel is low or a command, URL or description is long
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当面板较低或命令、URL 或描述较长时，权限提示会切断其“否”按钮、回复字段或标题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed failed or blocked tool calls showing no reason or a reason cut short, and Glob and Grep counting an error as results
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了失败或阻止的工具调用，显示无原因或原因缩短，并且 Glob 和 Grep 将错误计为结果

entries.en: Added a confirmation before `/install-github-app` changes a repository
entries.zh: 在 `/install-github-app` 更改存储库之前添加了确认

entries.en: Added `claude mcp add-json <name> -` to read the server's JSON from stdin, so tokens can stay off the command line; not available inside a Claude Code session
entries.zh: 添加了`claude mcp add-json <name> -`以从标准输入读取服务器的 JSON，因此令牌可以远离命令行；在 Claude Code 会话中不可用

entries.en: Added a line when a resumed session's earlier messages can't be loaded
entries.zh: 当无法加载已恢复会话的早期消息时添加了一行

entries.en: Added a list in `/status` of broken agent, skill, command and output style files, keybinding errors, an unavailable sandbox, ignored permission settings and hook matchers that never match
entries.zh: 在`/status`中添加了损坏的代理、技能、命令和输出样式文件、键绑定错误、不可用的沙箱、忽略的权限设置和从不匹配的挂钩匹配器的列表

entries.en: Added a note in `/config` when other settings override a row
entries.zh: 当其他设置覆盖一行时在`/config`中添加了注释

entries.en: Added `x-claude-code-managed-settings-checksum` to the gateway hint headers; sent where managed settings set `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`, including where they already do
entries.zh: 在网关提示标头中添加了“x-claude-code-management-settings-checksum”；在托管设置设置`CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`的位置发送，包括它们已经设置的位置

entries.en: Added support for naming a session's billing group with the `attributionProject` setting, for Claude apps gateways that set `admin.billing_group_tag`
entries.zh: 添加了对使用`attributionProject`设置命名会话的计费组的支持，适用于设置`admin.billing_group_tag`的 Claude 应用程序网关

entries.en: Added `/tui classic` as the name for the non-fullscreen renderer; `/tui default` still works
entries.zh: 添加`/tui classic`作为非全屏渲染器的名称； `/tui default` 仍然有效

entries.en: Changed some pre-started background sessions to be discarded after an account change
entries.zh: 更改了一些预先启动的后台会话，以便在帐户更改后丢弃

entries.en: Changed a workflow paused at a usage limit in the terminal to stay paused after a login, until the earlier login returns or you type a prompt
entries.zh: 将终端中在使用限制处暂停的工作流程更改为在登录后保持暂停状态，直到先前的登录返回或您键入提示

entries.en: Improved the speed of a session's first Bash command: shell start-up files may now run before it's approved, even if it's refused; set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SHELL_HEAD_START=1` to turn this off
entries.zh: 提高了会话第一个 Bash 命令的速度：shell 启动文件现在可以在批准之前运行，即使它被拒绝；设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SHELL_HEAD_START=1` 将其关闭

entries.en: Improved commits on newer models and in PowerShell: Claude is now told not to commit files that likely contain secrets
entries.zh: 改进了新模型和 PowerShell 中的提交：Claude 现在被告知不要提交可能包含机密的文件

entries.en: Improved sandboxed shell commands: Claude now sees when a command exempt from the sandbox stayed in it because its permission check relied on the sandbox
entries.zh: 改进的沙盒 shell 命令：克劳德现在可以看到不受沙盒约束的命令何时保留在其中，因为其权限检查依赖于沙盒

entries.en: Improved the refusal for shell commands with no `rm` that the dangerous `rm` check can't parse, so Claude can resend harmless ones in plain syntax instead of giving up
entries.zh: 改进了对没有`rm`的 shell 命令的拒绝，危险的`rm`检查无法解析，因此克劳德可以用简单的语法重新发送无害的命令，而不是放弃

entries.en: Improved resuming very long sessions: a transcript read that ends early is now retried once, so messages are lost less often
entries.zh: 改进了恢复非常长的会话：提前结束的转录读取现在会重试一次，因此消息丢失的频率会降低

entries.en: Improved subagent answers that hit the output token limit twice: they now more often come back whole or say up front that they are partial
entries.zh: 改进的子代理答案两次达到输出令牌限制：它们现在更经常完整地返回或预先声明它们是部分的

entries.en: Improved long replies on unrecognized models: a reply cut at 32,000 output tokens now continues with a limit of 128,000
entries.zh: 改进了对无法识别模型的长回复：回复削减为 32,000 个输出令牌，现在继续限制为 128,000 个

entries.en: Improved the reminder about a completed subagent after compaction: if Claude can't read the agent's output file, it is now told to ask the agent with `SendMessage`
entries.zh: 改进了压缩后有关已完成子代理的提醒：如果 Claude 无法读取代理的输出文件，现在会被告知使用`SendMessage`询问代理

entries.en: Improved the warning shown when an API key and an Anthropic profile are both set: it now says which one is in use and how to switch to the profile
entries.zh: 改进了同时设置 API 密钥和 Anthropic 配置文件时显示的警告：它现在显示正在使用哪一个以及如何切换到配置文件

entries.en: Improved `/plugin`: the question before removing a marketplace now says that its plugins' settings and saved data are deleted, and a marketplace's page no longer shows another marketplace's error
entries.zh: 改进了`/plugin`：删除市场之前的问题现在表明其插件的设置和保存的数据已被删除，并且市场的页面不再显示另一个市场的错误

entries.en: Improved startup time on Windows when PATH points to Git for Windows' bin folder, by starting git.exe directly instead of through its launcher
entries.zh: 当 PATH 指向 Git for Windows 的 bin 文件夹时，通过直接启动 git.exe 而不是通过其启动器，改进了 Windows 上的启动时间

entries.en: Improved how soon the Bash tool's diff of changed files is ready in auto and bypass permissions modes
entries.zh: 改进了 Bash 工具的更改文件差异在自动和绕过权限模式下准备就绪的速度

entries.en: Improved speed of the Bash permission check on very deeply nested missing paths on macOS and Linux, and of secret masking on very long text with a URL
entries.zh: 提高了对 macOS 和 Linux 上非常深层嵌套的缺失路径进行 Bash 权限检查的速度，以及对带有 URL 的超长文本进行秘密屏蔽的速度

entries.en: Improved transcript search to find text in edits and written files
entries.zh: 改进了转录搜索以查找编辑和书面文件中的文本

entries.en: Improved speed of reading large PNG images, and the quality of the JPEG sent in their place
entries.zh: 提高了读取大型 PNG 图像的速度以及代替其发送的 JPEG 的质量

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool to read an uploaded file by the address the artifact's page shows; other forms still fail, most with a message that says to read uploads one per call, by id
entries.zh: 改进了 Artifact 工具，可以通过 Artifact 页面显示的地址读取上传的文件；其他表单仍然失败，大多数都会显示一条消息，提示每次调用时按 ID 读取上传一个

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool to ignore `prompt`, `limit` and `label` on some calls that do not use them instead of failing the call
entries.zh: 改进了 Artifact 工具，以忽略某些不使用`prompt`、`limit`和`label`的调用，而不是使调用失败

entries.en: Improved MCP server pages in `/mcp`: local, remote and agent servers share one layout, menus end in Back, and actions are no longer numbered outside screen reader mode; use the arrow keys and Enter
entries.zh: 改进了`/mcp`中的 MCP 服务器页面：本地、远程和代理服务器共享一个布局，菜单以“后退”结尾，操作在屏幕阅读器模式之外不再编号；使用箭头键和 Enter

entries.en: Improved narrow terminals: `/status`, forms and detail screens lay out better, `/model` and `/effort` fit at about 40 columns, and key hints such as `←/→ to adjust` stay
entries.zh: 改进的窄终端：`/status`、表单和详细信息屏幕布局更好，`/model`和`/effort`适合大约 40 列，并且保留“←/→ 调整”等关键提示

entries.en: Improved `/install-github-app`: the repository, secret and API key steps use the standard list and keys, with shorter messages, a spinner and clearer errors
entries.zh: 改进了`/install-github-app`：存储库、秘密和 API 密钥步骤使用标准列表和密钥，消息更短，旋转器和更清晰的错误

entries.en: Improved `/desktop`: the download question is a standard list instead of y/n
entries.zh: 改进了`/desktop`：下载问题是标准列表，而不是 y/n

entries.en: Changed `ExitWorktree` to ask before removing a worktree that may hold unsaved work; refused in don't-ask mode or with nobody to answer, unless an allow rule, auto or bypass permissions mode allows it
entries.zh: 将`ExitWorktree`更改为在删除可能保存未保存工作的工作树之前进行询问；在“不询问”模式或无人应答的情况下被拒绝，除非允许规则、自动或绕过权限模式允许

entries.en: Changed `claude mcp add --scope project` to stop, instead of overwriting the file, when `.mcp.json` lists its servers at the top level with no `mcpServers` key
entries.zh: 当`.mcp.json`在顶层列出其服务器而没有`mcpServers`键时，将`claude mcp add --scope project`更改为停止，而不是覆盖文件

entries.en: Changed the arrow keys on most permission prompts to stop at No instead of wrapping around; a number past the last answer moves to No
entries.zh: 将大多数权限提示上的箭头键更改为在“否”处停止而不是环绕；最后一个答案后面的数字移至“否”

entries.en: Changed path checks to refuse some symbolic links
entries.zh: 更改了路径检查以拒绝某些符号链接

entries.en: Changed what counts as inside a working directory, so some paths now ask for permission
entries.zh: 更改了工作目录内的内容，因此某些路径现在需要许可

entries.en: Changed `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` to ask about more Bash commands in bypass and auto modes, and to deny some in auto mode
entries.zh: 更改了`permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`以在旁路和自动模式下询问更多 Bash 命令，并在自动模式下拒绝一些命令

entries.en: Changed `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` to refuse more Bash commands that name a path under a Read or Edit deny rule, where it used to ask
entries.zh: 更改了`permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`以拒绝更多在读取或编辑拒绝规则下命名路径的 Bash 命令，它过去会询问

entries.en: Changed auto mode's notice about falling back to billed classifier requests to say that an upcoming release removes the fallback; each action it would have checked will be asked about or denied
entries.zh: 更改了自动模式关于回退到计费分类器请求的通知，表示即将发布的版本将删除回退；它要检查的每个操作都会被询问或拒绝

entries.en: Changed auto mode to ignore more allow rules that run any package, like `Bash(pnpm dlx *)`, and path or version forms of ones it already ignored (`/usr/bin/npm run:*`); the safety check decides those
entries.zh: 更改了自动模式以忽略运行任何包的更多允许规则，例如`Bash(pnpm dlx *)`，以及已忽略的路径或版本形式(`/usr/bin/npm run:*`)；安全检查决定那些

entries.en: Changed `/sandbox` and most `/config` value lists to be unnumbered outside screen reader mode; use the arrow keys and Enter
entries.zh: 将`/sandbox`和大多数`/config`值列表更改为在屏幕阅读器模式之外无编号；使用箭头键和 Enter

entries.en: Changed Bash commands whose variables expand to very long text to be denied, with a message that says to use shorter values or a file
entries.zh: 更改了变量扩展为很长文本的 Bash 命令被拒绝，并显示一条消息，提示使用较短的值或文件

entries.en: Changed the PowerShell tool to ask before one more command, even under a rule naming it; if nothing answers, it's refused unless a whole-tool rule, auto mode or bypass permissions mode allows it
entries.zh: 更改了 PowerShell 工具，使其在另一个命令之前询问，即使是在命名它的规则下；如果没有任何答案，则会被拒绝，除非整体工具规则、自动模式或绕过权限模式允许

entries.en: Changed a subagent resumed by a sibling's message to follow the session's permission settings; it may now ask, or be refused where nobody can answer
entries.zh: 更改了由兄弟消息恢复的子代理以遵循会话的权限设置；它现在可能会询问，或者在无人能回答的情况下被拒绝

entries.en: Changed `--worktree` with a relative `--add-dir` beside the launch folder to give the Bash sandbox that folder, not one beside the worktree
entries.zh: 将启动文件夹旁边的`--worktree`更改为相对的`--add-dir`，为 Bash 沙箱提供该文件夹，而不是工作树旁边的文件夹

entries.en: Changed some `--worktree` starts with a relative `--add-dir` above the launch folder, such as `..`, to give the Bash sandbox, and a `--bg` session, only the worktree
entries.zh: 更改了一些在启动文件夹上方以相对的`--add-dir`开头的`--worktree`，例如`..`，以提供 Bash 沙箱和`--bg`会话，仅提供工作树

entries.en: Changed Claude in Chrome to refuse uploading some credential files; attach those to the page yourself
entries.zh: 更改Chrome中的Claude拒绝上传某些凭证文件；自己将它们附加到页面上

entries.en: Changed artifact approval in organizations that require it for each new artifact: an artifact that only a plugin created or allowed can be refused
entries.zh: 更改了组织中需要每个新工件的工件批准：只有插件创建或允许的工件才能被拒绝

entries.en: Changed sessions with nobody to ask to refuse a new artifact at once, with no permission prompt, in organizations that require approval of each one
entries.zh: 在需要批准每个工件的组织中，更改了没有人要求立即拒绝新工件的会话，没有权限提示

entries.en: Changed the Artifact tool to refuse calls once settings turn Artifacts off, in sessions already running too
entries.zh: 更改了 Artifact 工具，一旦设置关闭 Artifacts，即在已经运行的会话中拒绝呼叫

entries.en: Changed the Artifact publish prompt to stop offering "don't ask again" in subagents and after a background task result, someone else's message or a compaction
entries.zh: 更改了 Artifact 发布提示，以停止在子代理中以及在后台任务结果、其他人的消息或压缩之后提供“不再询问”

entries.en: Changed `claude plugin eval` to keep its deny rules over a plugin's permission hook, and to flag calls the hook let through
entries.zh: 更改了`claude plugin eval`以保留其对插件权限挂钩的拒绝规则，并标记挂钩允许通过的调用

entries.en: Changed MCP server logs to record the mode, action, and field names of elicitation requests and hook answers, not their full contents
entries.zh: 更改了 MCP 服务器日志以记录诱导请求和挂钩答案的模式、操作和字段名称，而不是其完整内容

entries.en: Changed most prompts to ignore answers other than Esc for a moment after resuming with `fg`
entries.zh: 更改了大多数提示，以在使用`fg`恢复后暂时忽略除 Esc 之外的答案

entries.en: Changed Code Mode to no longer refuse to start when an installed mod hooks tool calls; an administrator can still keep Code Mode off in managed settings
entries.zh: 更改了代码模式，当已安装的 mod hooks 工具调用时不再拒绝启动；管理员仍然可以在托管设置中关闭代码模式

entries.en: Changed subagents launched without a model to stay on the model they started on when resumed, including after `/model`
entries.zh: 更改了在没有模型的情况下启动的子代理，使其保持在恢复时启动的模型上，包括在`/model`之后

entries.en: Changed the first subagent on a model to wait up to 1.5 seconds (10 in `claude -p`) for that model's settings from Anthropic, instead of starting without them
entries.zh: 将模型上的第一个子代理更改为等待 1.5 秒（在`claude -p`中为 10 秒）以获取来自 Anthropic 的模型设置，而不是在没有它们的情况下启动

entries.en: Changed restarted background subagents, and turns that start by themselves, to wait for plugins to load
entries.zh: 更改了重新启动的后台子代理，并自行启动以等待插件加载

entries.en: Changed prompt history to leave out most launch prompts of sessions that another Claude Code session started, such as `claude --bg` run by Claude
entries.zh: 更改了提示历史记录，以忽略另一个 Claude Code 会话启动的会话的大多数启动提示，例如 Claude 运行的`claude --bg`

entries.en: Changed subagent progress summaries in terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry to be written from short notes, not the whole conversation, using far fewer tokens
entries.zh: 将 Amazon Bedrock、Google Vertex AI 和 Microsoft Foundry 上的终端会话中的子代理进度摘要更改为从简短笔记编写，而不是整个对话，使用更少的令牌

entries.en: Changed non-interactive (`-p`) mode to run fewer git commands before the first request
entries.zh: 更改了非交互式（`-p`）模式以在第一个请求之前运行更少的 git 命令

entries.en: Changed first-run setup to skip terminal setup in remote VS Code, Cursor and Devin Desktop sessions, where it cannot change settings
entries.zh: 更改了首次运行设置以跳过远程 VS Code、Cursor 和 Devin Desktop 会话中的终端设置，在这些会话中无法更改设置

entries.en: Changed fullscreen text selection to leave out the glyph of system, thinking and inbound message lines
entries.zh: 更改了全屏文本选择以省略系统、思考和入站消息行的字形

entries.en: Changed Anthropic-hosted cloud sessions to ignore more of a repository's flag and plugin delivery settings; its `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` now acts at most as `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`
entries.zh: 更改了 Anthropic 托管的云会话，以忽略更多存储库的标志和插件交付设置；它的`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`现在最多充当`DISABLE_TELEMETRY`

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runners with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` deleting a non-empty directory named by `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` at startup: the runner now keeps it, ignores the variable and warns
entries.zh: 修复了使用`--use-anthropic-git-proxy`在启动时删除由`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`命名的非空目录的自托管运行程序：运行程序现在保留它，忽略变量并发出警告

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp add` and `claude mcp remove` with project scope deleting other top-level keys from `.mcp.json`, such as `$schema` or another tool's `servers`
entries.zh: 修复了`claude mcp add`和`claude mcp remove`，项目范围从`.mcp.json`中删除其他顶级键，例如`$schema`或其他工具的`servers`

entries.en: Fixed `/export` overwriting an existing file without asking: the dialog now asks, and `/export <name>` keeps the file and says to run `/export`
entries.zh: 修复了`/export`在不询问的情况下覆盖现有文件的问题：对话框现在会询问，并且`/export <name>`保留文件并表示运行`/export`

entries.en: Fixed a command you had allowed still running after you pressed Stop, when the approval arrived after a restart, in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions with no feature flags loaded
entries.zh: 修复了在云和自托管运行器会话中，在未加载功能标志的云和自托管运行器会话中，您在按下“停止”后仍允许运行的命令，当重新启动后获得批准时

entries.en: Fixed Enter closing `/teleport`'s load error screen
entries.zh: 修复了 Enter 关闭 `/teleport` 的加载错误屏幕

entries.en: Fixed a click followed by Enter in `/plugin` installing or disabling a plugin
entries.zh: 修复了在`/plugin`中单击后按 Enter 安装或禁用插件的问题

entries.en: Fixed a half-typed `!` command running on an extra Enter after the usage limit menu
entries.zh: 修复了在使用限制菜单后额外输入一个 Enter 时运行的半输入`!`命令

entries.en: Fixed some `--disallowedTools` rules with parentheses in their content
entries.zh: 修复了一些内容中带有括号的`--disallowedTools`规则

entries.en: Fixed auto mode ignoring some wildcard PowerShell allow rules that name a script with `.\`, such as `PowerShell(.\scripts\build.ps1 *)`
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式忽略某些通配符 PowerShell 允许使用`.\`命名脚本的规则，例如`PowerShell(.\scripts\build.ps1 *)`

entries.en: Fixed a running Code Mode script in auto mode getting permission prompts and denials once Claude started a second script that auto mode also allowed
entries.zh: 修复了在自动模式下运行的代码模式脚本在克劳德启动自动模式也允许的第二个脚本时获取权限提示和拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed a nested `claude` with its own token being refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID`: commands that don't get the session's token no longer get its `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES`; set it on any that need it
entries.zh: 修复了嵌套的`claude`，其自己的令牌被`forceLoginOrgUUID`拒绝：未获取会话令牌的命令不再获取其`CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES`；将其设置在任何需要它的地方

entries.en: Fixed headless sessions losing stored messages on resume when a message was sent again with the same UUID after the process was killed
entries.zh: 修复了进程被终止后，使用相同 UUID 再次发送消息时无头会话在恢复时丢失存储的消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed cases where a session resumed after an empty reply or a killed command lost an answer, or brought back a rewound prompt, after another crash or a move to the background
entries.zh: 修复了会话在空回复或被杀死的命令丢失答案后恢复，或在另一次崩溃或移动到后台后带回倒带提示的情况

entries.en: Fixed a remote session forgetting messages sent after Stop was pressed during a restart, if Claude Code then crashed
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话忘记在重新启动期间按下“停止”后发送的消息（如果克劳德代码崩溃）的问题

entries.en: Fixed tasks created after `/clear` being lost, and cleared tasks coming back, when a cloud or self-hosted runner session with no feature flags loaded resumed later
entries.zh: 修复了`/clear`丢失后创建的任务，以及当稍后恢复未加载功能标志的云或自托管运行器会话时清除的任务返回的问题

entries.en: Fixed a compaction right after a reply cut at the output token limit losing that reply's tool call and its result
entries.zh: 修复了在输出令牌限制处回复剪切后立即进行的压缩，丢失了该回复的工具调用及其结果

entries.en: Fixed a settings change from `/config` and similar commands failing to save with no warning; a line under the prompt now says so
entries.zh: 修复了`/config`的设置更改和类似命令无法保存且没有警告的问题；现在提示符下有一行这样说

entries.en: Fixed `/rewind` closing without a word when some files could not be restored
entries.zh: 修复了某些文件无法恢复时`/rewind`无声关闭的问题

entries.en: Fixed pasted images being dropped when the prompt starts with a file path such as `/tmp/a.txt`
entries.zh: 修复了当提示以`/tmp/a.txt`等文件路径开头时粘贴的图像被删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed agents passed with `--agents` being lost once plugins loaded or reloaded
entries.zh: 修复了加载或重新加载插件后通过`--agents`传递的代理丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's agent being dropped when resuming a session from the `--resume` picker
entries.zh: 修复了从`--resume`选择器恢复会话时插件代理被删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code refusing to start when `https_proxy` or `HTTPS_PROXY` is a bare `host:port` and neither its input nor its output is a terminal (the desktop app, an SDK, cron)
entries.zh: 修复了当`https_proxy`或`HTTPS_PROXY`是裸露的`host:port`且其输入和输出都不是终端（桌面应用程序、SDK、cron）时克劳德代码拒绝启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code on Linux sometimes returning to the shell while restarting itself at startup, such as after the first sign-in to a Claude apps gateway or when turning on Code Mode
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上的 Claude Code 有时在启动时重新启动时返回 shell 的问题，例如首次登录 Claude 应用程序网关后或打开代码模式时

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` hanging before its first request when the fetch of a model's settings stalled, such as at a proxy; it now goes on without them after 10 seconds
entries.zh: 修复了当模型设置的获取停滞时（例如在代理处），`claude -p`在第一个请求之前挂起的问题；现在 10 秒后，如果没有它们，它也会继续

entries.en: Fixed the screen staying blank or frozen after a brief out-of-memory error
entries.zh: 修复了短暂的内存不足错误后屏幕保持空白或冻结的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rare display fault that could freeze the screen or end the session
entries.zh: 修复了一个罕见的显示故障，该故障可能会冻结屏幕或结束会话

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions breaking when a program left thousands of connections open to the session's network proxy
entries.zh: 修复了当程序向会话的网络代理打开数千个连接时云会话中断的问题

entries.en: Fixed a turn hanging when a mod's `$.model.complete` or `$.model.classify` call met a usage limit: the call now gets the API's error at once; mods should handle that error
entries.zh: 修复了当 mod 的 `$.model.complete` 或 `$.model.classify` 调用达到使用限制时挂起的问题：调用现在立即获取 API 的错误； mods 应该处理该错误

entries.en: Fixed stalls on a compaction reply with thousands of unclosed tags and on some very long WebFetch URLs; WebFetch now refuses a URL over 2,000 characters before any permission prompt
entries.zh: 修复了具有数千个未封闭标签的压缩回复和一些非常长的 WebFetch URL 上的停顿； WebFetch 现在在任何权限提示之前拒绝超过 2,000 个字符的 URL

entries.en: Fixed a message with thousands of `@` mentions stalling before Claude replies; only the first 100 mentions are now looked up as files
entries.zh: 修复了一条包含数千个`@`提及的消息在克劳德回复之前停滞的问题；现在仅将前 100 个提及作为文件进行查找

entries.en: Fixed the prompt freezing after rejecting a write to a very large file; a rejected write now shows a short preview
entries.zh: 修复了拒绝写入超大文件后提示冻结的问题；被拒绝的写入现在会显示简短的预览

entries.en: Fixed a crash when a burst of keys reached the search box in `/plugin`
entries.zh: 修复了当一系列按键到达`/plugin`中的搜索框时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed a false crash report and exit code when a suspended session resumes, or at exit, where a Linux security policy blocks a process from signalling itself
entries.zh: 修复了挂起的会话恢复时或退出时的错误崩溃报告和退出代码，其中 Linux 安全策略阻止进程向自身发送信号

entries.en: Fixed remote MCP servers staying disconnected after a longer outage such as a VPN drop: most servers on other machines reached by hostname over https are now retried in the background for about a day
entries.zh: 修复了远程 MCP 服务器在长时间中断（例如 VPN 断开）后保持断开连接的问题：通过 https 主机名访问的其他计算机上的大多数服务器现在会在后台重试大约一天

entries.en: Fixed Edit refusing with "File has not been read yet" after a compaction on unchanged files outside the project that Claude had already read in full
entries.zh: 修复了在压缩克劳德已完整阅读的项目外未更改的文件后编辑拒绝“文件尚未读取”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Grep repeating or skipping results when paging with `head_limit` and `offset`; content and count results are now sorted by file path
entries.zh: 修复了 Grep 在使用`head_limit`和`offset`分页时重复或跳过结果的问题；内容和计数结果现在按文件路径排序

entries.en: Fixed Read failing on Jupyter notebooks that contain an output of an unknown type
entries.zh: 修复了包含未知类型输出的 Jupyter 笔记本上的读取失败问题

entries.en: Fixed NotebookEdit removing the notebook file's final newline
entries.zh: 修复了 NotebookEdit 删除笔记本文件最后换行符的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Read tool reporting 512KB instead of the real size when a file of 10 MB or more is too large to read at once
entries.zh: 修复了当 10 MB 或更大的文件太大而无法一次读取时，读取工具报告 512KB 而不是实际大小

entries.en: Fixed the Bash tool's diff of changed files not naming files that are binary, too large or too many to show
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具的已更改文件的差异，未命名二进制文件、太大或太多而无法显示

entries.en: Fixed artifact publishes failing with "the source file changed between approval and publish" when a synced or remote-backed folder had only changed the file's timestamp
entries.zh: 修复了当同步或远程支持的文件夹仅更改了文件的时间戳时，工件发布失败并显示“源文件在批准和发布之间发生更改”的问题

entries.en: Fixed a new artifact that you approved being refused in a cloud scheduled task's session, in organizations that require approval of each new artifact
entries.zh: 修复了您批准的新工件在需要批准每个新工件的组织中在云计划任务会话中被拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed a new artifact being refused after an app built on the Agent SDK approved it, in organizations that require approval of each new artifact
entries.zh: 修复了在需要批准每个新工件的组织中，在基于 Agent SDK 构建的应用程序批准后新工件被拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/artifacts` showing part of your list, or "No artifacts yet", when a request for more of the list failed: it now tries again, then warns if it can't load the whole list
entries.zh: 修复了`/artifacts`在请求更多列表失败时显示列表的一部分或“尚无工件”的问题：现在它会再次尝试，然后在无法加载整个列表时发出警告

entries.en: Fixed in-process agent teammates on a different model from the lead compacting at the lead's context limit and on the wrong model; they now use their own limit and model, at that model's rate
entries.zh: 修复了进程内代理队友在与线索上下文限制不同的模型上以及错误的模型上进行压缩的问题；他们现在使用自己的极限和模型，以该模型的速率

entries.en: Fixed a finished subagent resuming on the model and effort of a sibling subagent that messaged it
entries.zh: 修复了已完成的子代理在模型上的恢复以及向其发送消息的同级子代理的工作量

entries.en: Fixed the main conversation not being told a background agent had finished when the subagent that started it ended by itself without reading the result, outside auto mode
entries.zh: 修复了当启动主对话的子代理在没有读取结果的情况下自行结束（在自动模式之外）时，主对话不会被告知后台代理已完成的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude reporting a background agent as still running when it had waited 30 seconds or more on a permission prompt in the desktop app, on the web and in the SDK
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 在桌面应用程序、Web 和 SDK 中出现权限提示后等待 30 秒或更长时间后报告后台代理仍在运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude not being told in auto mode when a background agent's reply to a follow-up message was dropped, and reduced repeat wake-ups there from agents waiting on background commands
entries.zh: 修复了当后台代理对后续消息的回复被删除时，克劳德在自动模式下不会被告知的问题，并减少了等待后台命令的代理的重复唤醒

entries.en: Fixed the desktop app, Claude Code on the web and VS Code showing a raw task notification as a subagent's prompt after its background task woke it
entries.zh: 修复了桌面应用程序、Web 上的 Claude Code 和 VS Code 在后台任务唤醒子代理后将原始任务通知显示为子代理的提示

entries.en: Fixed messages sent from another session with "later" priority joining the running turn, instead of waiting for it to end, in Remote Control and Claude Desktop sessions
entries.zh: 修复了在远程控制和 Claude 桌面会话中从另一个具有“稍后”优先级的会话发送的消息，加入正在运行的回合，而不是等待其结束

entries.en: Fixed messages to cloud and Remote Control sessions being reported as failed with a stale address after a timeout or rate limit; Claude now says when a message may have arrived
entries.zh: 修复了在超时或速率限制后发送到云和远程控制会话的消息被报告为失败且地址过时的问题；克劳德现在说消息何时可能到达

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions giving no error when a `UserPromptSubmit` hook blocks a message sent while Claude works
entries.zh: 修复了当`UserPromptSubmit`挂钩阻止克劳德工作时发送的消息时，云会话不会出现错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed failing hooks showing nothing: SubagentStop in background agents, SessionEnd at `/clear` and `/resume`, and CwdChanged and FileChanged in fullscreen
entries.zh: 修复了不显示任何内容的失败挂钩：后台代理中的 SubagentStop、`/clear`和`/resume`处的 SessionEnd，以及全屏中的 CwdChanged 和 FileChanged

entries.en: Fixed a Stop hook that failed to run being shown as having reported a problem
entries.zh: 修复了无法运行的 Stop 挂钩显示为已报告问题的问题

entries.en: Fixed focus view keeping a finished reply hidden while a Stop hook was running
entries.zh: 固定焦点视图在 Stop 挂钩运行时隐藏已完成的回复

entries.en: Fixed Claude getting a long managed PostToolUse hook output twice when a mod added context to the tool call
entries.zh: 修复了当 mod 将上下文添加到工具调用时，Claude 两次获得长期托管的 PostToolUse 挂钩输出

entries.en: Fixed `/model` listing the wrong models in some terminal sessions when a project's `.claude/settings.json` sets `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` to an LLM gateway
entries.zh: 修复了当项目的`.claude/settings.json`将`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`设置为 LLM 网关时，`/model`在某些终端会话中列出错误的模型

entries.en: Fixed `/statusline` writing to `~/.claude/settings.json` when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` points to another folder
entries.zh: 修复了当`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`指向另一个文件夹时`/statusline`写入`~/.claude/settings.json`的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claudeMdExcludes` patterns on Windows not matching a path whose drive letter is written in the other case
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的`claudeMdExcludes`模式与在其他情况下写入的驱动器号的路径不匹配的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` and `claude rm` refusing to remove a fully pushed session ("The worktree has unpushed commits") when its worktree has a file or folder named `HEAD` at the top level
entries.zh: 修复了当工作树顶层有一个名为`HEAD`的文件或文件夹时，“claude Agents”和`claude rm`拒绝删除完全推送的会话（“工作树有未推送的提交”）

entries.en: Fixed long ListAgents results hiding most sessions on accounts with many cloud or Remote Control sessions: long lists now come in pages
entries.zh: 修复了长 ListAgents 结果隐藏具有许多云或远程控制会话的帐户上的大多数会话的问题：长列表现在出现在页面中

entries.en: Fixed slow turns in resumed sessions for organizations with tens of thousands of connector tool permissions
entries.zh: 修复了具有数万个连接器工具权限的组织恢复会话缓慢的问题

entries.en: Fixed the spend limit menu reporting a changed limit when the server refused it
entries.zh: 修复了支出限制菜单在服务器拒绝时报告更改的限制

entries.en: Fixed a second `x` on a task's details in `/tasks` stopping the next task too
entries.zh: 修复了`/tasks`中任务详细信息上的第二个`x`，也会停止下一个任务

entries.en: Fixed Esc being ignored on a permission prompt that had just appeared
entries.zh: 修复了刚刚出现的权限提示时 Esc 被忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed lists that load their rows late sometimes ignoring Enter and the arrow keys
entries.zh: 修复了延迟加载行的列表有时会忽略 Enter 和箭头键的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/autofix-pr` holding the keyboard after Esc while it stopped the cloud session; the dialog now closes at once, and a stop that fails is reported afterwards with a link
entries.zh: 修复了`/autofix-pr`在停止云会话时在 Esc 后按住键盘的问题；该对话框现在立即关闭，随后会通过链接报告失败的停止

entries.en: Fixed a blank screen and stray mouse codes in the shell after quitting with ctrl+c just after ← opens the agents view
entries.zh: 修复了在 ← 打开代理视图后使用 ctrl+c 退出后 shell 中的空白屏幕和流浪鼠标代码

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C right after the trust question leaving the terminal in fullscreen
entries.zh: 修复了信任问题后 Ctrl+C 使终端全屏显示的问题

entries.en: Fixed the shell flashing on screen when ← opens the agents view in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了当 ← 在全屏模式下打开代理视图时 shell 在屏幕上闪烁的问题

entries.en: Fixed terminal display faults: most scrambled scrollback in Ghostty on resize, link addresses hidden in Windows Terminal under old tmux and in VTE 0.50.0, and no selection highlight with 16 colors
entries.zh: 修复了终端显示故障：调整大小时 Ghostty 中最混乱的回滚、旧 tmux 和 VTE 0.50.0 下的 Windows 终端中隐藏的链接地址，以及没有 16 种颜色的选择突出显示

entries.en: Fixed some garbled rows in tmux with `allow-passthrough` on inside kitty, Ghostty or iTerm2
entries.zh: 修复了 tmux 中的一些乱码行，其中包含 kitty、Ghostty 或 iTerm2 上的`allow-passthrough`

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp` saying no servers were configured after one was added during a session or declined; it now says what to do
entries.zh: 修复了`/mcp`表示在会话期间添加或拒绝服务器后未配置服务器的问题；它现在说要做什么

entries.en: Fixed `/hooks` leaving out hooks given by `--settings`
entries.zh: 修复了`/hooks`遗漏了`--settings`给出的钩子的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/` menu listing a row for each skill of the same name, though every row ran the first
entries.zh: 修复了`/`菜单，为同名的每个技能列出一行，尽管每行都运行第一个

entries.en: Fixed `/teleport` showing no message when the chosen session failed to resume
entries.zh: 修复了当所选会话无法恢复时`/teleport`不显示消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed n and N in transcript search skipping matches
entries.zh: 修复了成绩单搜索中的 n 和 N 跳过匹配的问题

entries.en: Fixed cancelling a transcript search (ctrl+o, then /) in a long session landing far from where the search started
entries.zh: 修复了在远离搜索开始位置的长会话中取消转录搜索（ctrl+o，然后 /）的问题

entries.en: Fixed up and down losing the cursor's column over a short or blank line
entries.zh: 修复了在短行或空行上上下丢失光标的列的问题

entries.en: Fixed Tab in shell mode filling in a file name after `&&`, `;` or `|`, where a command goes
entries.zh: 修复了 shell 模式下的 Tab 在命令所在位置`&&`、`;`或`|`后填写文件名的问题

entries.en: Fixed the selected session leaving the screen in `claude --resume` and `/resume` when branch names or folder paths are long
entries.zh: 修复了当分支名称或文件夹路径很长时，所选会话在`claude --resume`和`/resume`中留下屏幕的问题

entries.en: Fixed the MCP tool list in `/mcp` and `/plugin` losing your place when going back from a tool
entries.zh: 修复了`/mcp`和`/plugin`中的 MCP 工具列表在从工具返回时丢失位置的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` listing one session fewer than the window has room for, and a 'Resend your message' hint after most spend caps, where resending can't help
entries.zh: 修复了`/resume`列出的会话数少于窗口空间的问题，以及在大多数支出上限后出现“重新发送消息”提示（在这种情况下重新发送无济于事）

entries.en: Fixed an MCP server's long question being cut off after one row, text fields hiding long pastes with no sign, and a doubled divider line in `/plugin`'s options and `/login`'s Bedrock and Vertex steps
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 服务器的长问题在一行后被切断、文本字段隐藏没有符号的长粘贴以及`/plugin`选项和`/login`的基岩和顶点步骤中的双分隔线

entries.en: Fixed the "+N lines" count being too high for command output with links or colors, and the transcript's `?` help hiding how to exit in a short window
entries.zh: 修复了“+N 行”计数对于带有链接或颜色的命令输出来说过高的问题，并且记录的“？”有助于隐藏如何在短窗口中退出

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C twice not closing `/chrome` from its browser list
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+C 两次未从浏览器列表中关闭`/chrome`的问题

entries.en: Fixed a number and Enter typed too early at an agent's plan approval in screen reader mode causing the next number to be dropped too
entries.zh: 修复了在屏幕阅读器模式下在代理计划批准时过早输入数字和 Enter 导致下一个数字也被删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude trying to read design system token files that do not exist when starting a deck or design
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德在启动套牌或设计时尝试读取不存在的设计系统令牌文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed exit not saying that a worktree was kept
entries.zh: 修复了退出时没有说保留工作树的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/hooks` help naming input fields that do not exist
entries.zh: 修复了`/hooks`帮助命名不存在的输入字段

entries.en: Fixed question dialogs naming ctrl+g after the external editor key was rebound
entries.zh: 修复了外部编辑器按键反弹后命名 ctrl+g 的问题对话框

entries.en: Fixed two sign-in error messages that pointed to the Claude subscription option on computers where `forceLoginMethod` is set to `console`
entries.zh: 修复了两条登录错误消息，这些消息指向`forceLoginMethod`设置为`console`的计算机上的 Claude 订阅选项

entries.en: Fixed `/config` saying the dialog was dismissed instead of "Set theme to …" after changing the theme
entries.zh: 修复了`/config`在更改主题后说对话框被关闭而不是“将主题设置为...”的问题

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Remote Control: Fixed stopping the server in worktree mode deleting a running session's git-ignored files, such as `.env`
entries.zh: 远程控制：修复了在工作树模式下停止服务器删除正在运行的会话的 git-ignored 文件的问题，例如`.env`

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed `claude -p` started by a session's script or hook waiting out rate limits, because it inherited the session's own retry setting
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了由会话脚本或挂钩等待速率限制启动的`claude -p`，因为它继承了会话自己的重试设置

entries.en: Windows: Improved start-up time with no Git Bash and no `pwsh` on PATH by checking PowerShell's standard install locations at once; System32's `powershell.exe` now wins over one earlier on PATH
entries.zh: Windows：通过立即检查 PowerShell 的标准安装位置，改进了在 PATH 上没有 Git Bash 和`pwsh`的情况下的启动时间； System32 的`powershell.exe`现在在 PATH 上胜过早期的一个

entries.en: Windows: Improved PowerShell tool speed by up to about half a second per command
entries.zh: Windows：将每个命令的 PowerShell 工具速度提高约半秒

entries.en: [VSCode] Added "Claude Code: Add to Chat" to the Explorer's right-click menu, which @-mentions the selected files and folders in the chat
entries.zh: [VSCode] 在资源管理器的右键菜单中添加了“Claude Code：添加到聊天”，该菜单@-提及聊天中选定的文件和文件夹

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt not showing the reason that a PreToolUse hook gives when it asks for confirmation (anthropics/claude-code#85950)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了权限提示未显示 PreToolUse 挂钩在要求确认时给出的原因的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#85950)

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed long tool and file names being cut off in a permission prompt's title
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了权限提示标题中长工具和文件名被截断的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a terminal session's diff showing the previous proposed edit after you typed in it and Claude edited the same file again
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了终端会话的差异，在您输入内容后显示先前建议的编辑，并且 Claude 再次编辑了同一文件

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Escape also stopping Claude's response when it closes the feedback or "Build a custom style" dialog, the @-mention menu, the model, mode or "+" menu, or another popup
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Escape 在关闭反馈或“构建自定义样式”对话框、@-提及菜单、模型、模式或“+”菜单或其他弹出窗口时也会停止 Claude 的响应

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved speed when Claude makes several edits in a row: queued edits share one wait for new problems; a problem may be reported with a later edit
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进了 Claude 连续进行多次编辑时的速度：排队的编辑共享一个等待新问题；稍后编辑可能会报告问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved @-mention file search speed in large workspaces when `rg` is on your `PATH`; results now rank much as in the terminal, with less tolerance for typos
entries.zh: [VSCode] 当`rg`位于`PATH`上时，提高了大型工作区中 @-mention 文件的搜索速度；结果现在的排名与终端中的排名相同，对拼写错误的容忍度较低

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved startup: the model picker is ready at once in folders opened for the first time, empty windows and worktrees, except on third-party providers
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进了启动：模型选择器在首次打开的文件夹、空窗口和工作树中立即准备就绪，第三方提供商除外

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed a chat edit's diff to stay open and keep asking for approval when a terminal session in the same window sends a prompt
entries.zh: [VSCode] 更改了聊天编辑的差异以保持打开状态，并在同一窗口中的终端会话发送提示时继续请求批准

entries.en: [VSCode] Removed unused tools from the IDE connection (openFile, saveDocument, getOpenEditors and related)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 从 IDE 连接中删除了未使用的工具（openFile、saveDocument、getOpenEditors 及相关）

entries.en: Added support for turning on Code Mode while agent teams are enabled; if you already turned it on, sessions with teams on now start in Code Mode
entries.zh: 添加了在启用代理团队时打开代码模式的支持；如果您已经打开它，则与团队的会话现在以代码模式开始

entries.en: Added a startup warning when an `--allowedTools`, `--disallowedTools` or `--tools` value has an entry that doesn't look like a complete rule
entries.zh: 添加了当`--allowedTools`、`--disallowedTools`或`--tools`值具有看起来不像完整规则的条目时的启动警告

entries.en: Added a message explaining why MCP servers stop loading when an administrator adds `managed-mcp.json` during a session
entries.zh: 添加了一条消息，解释了当管理员在会话期间添加“management-mcp.json”时，为什么 MCP 服务器停止加载

entries.en: Added a row to `/status` that says when your provider or an environment variable such as `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` turns features off
entries.zh: 在`/status`中添加了一行，指示您的提供程序或环境变量（例如`DISABLE_TELEMETRY`）何时关闭功能

entries.en: Added a note in `/plugin` and `claude plugin list` when a malformed `plugin.json` field such as `author` or `homepage` is ignored
entries.zh: 当忽略格式错误的`plugin.json`字段（例如`author`或`homepage`）时，在`/plugin`和“claude插件列表”中添加了注释

entries.en: Added Ctrl+O to show hidden startup notices
entries.zh: 添加 Ctrl+O 显示隐藏的启动通知

entries.en: Added a hint in the empty prompt that says what to do after a request fails
entries.zh: 在空提示中添加了提示，说明请求失败后该怎么做

entries.en: Added an `esc to stop` footer hint in a subagent's view where Esc would stop it
entries.zh: 在子代理的视图中添加了`esc to stop`页脚提示，Esc 将在其中停止它

entries.en: Added `OTEL_RESOURCE_INCLUDE_HOST` to include `host.name` and `host.id` in OpenTelemetry resource attributes (off by default)
entries.zh: 添加了`OTEL_RESOURCE_INCLUDE_HOST`以在 OpenTelemetry 资源属性中包含`host.name`和`host.id`（默认情况下关闭）

entries.en: Added `overflowX="scroll"` on a mod's `Box`, and `maxLines` and `wrap="clip"` on its `Text`
entries.zh: 在 mod 的 `Box` 上添加了 `overflowX="scroll"`，在其 `Text` 上添加了 `maxLines` 和 `wrap="clip"`

entries.en: Improved Bash permission checks: some commands now ask first, or are refused where no one can answer
entries.zh: 改进了 Bash 权限检查：某些命令现在首先询问，或者在无人回答的情况下被拒绝

entries.en: Improved permission checks in Code Mode; more sandboxed commands now ask or are refused
entries.zh: 改进了代码模式中的权限检查；更多沙盒命令现在询问或被拒绝

entries.en: Improved the messages shown when Code Mode can't be turned on, so they say what you can do
entries.zh: 改进了代码模式无法打开时显示的消息，以便它们告诉您可以做什么

entries.en: Improved Bash sandbox protections on macOS, Linux and WSL
entries.zh: 改进了 macOS、Linux 和 WSL 上的 Bash 沙箱保护

entries.en: Changed edits in a session's mods folder to ask more often, and sandboxed commands to write to fewer folders; if every edit asks, remove any link there to an unreadable or network path
entries.zh: 更改了会话 mods 文件夹中的编辑以更频繁地询问，并沙盒命令以写入更少的文件夹；如果每次编辑都要求，请删除指向不可读或网络路径的任何链接

entries.en: Improved Claude's sandbox instructions on Linux to explain that a server is reachable only from the command that started it
entries.zh: 改进了 Linux 上的克劳德沙箱指令，以解释服务器只能通过启动它的命令访问

entries.en: Improved how secrets are masked in push notifications from Remote Control and cloud sessions
entries.zh: 改进了远程控制和云会话的推送通知中隐藏秘密的方式
